prihlasovani-na-dubnove-campy-spusteno.titulek: Registration for the April camps is open
prihlasovani-na-dubnove-campy-spusteno.perex: If you're looking for a chance to level up your bike skills, you'll love our 2 camps for men and women. The season is approaching, so it's time to prepare properly. You'll practise everything from…
prihlasovani-na-dubnove-campy-spusteno.obsah:
If you're looking for a chance to level up your bike skills, you'll love our 2 camps for men and women. The season is approaching, so it's time to prepare properly. You'll practise everything from the basic stance and correct braking, balance and the pump track to riding over obstacles, drops and benches.

The camps are suitable for off-road beginners as well as intermediate riders, with groups split according to goals, motivation and ability if needed.

You can sign up for these camps.

beneficni-ples-podnikatelu-bublava.perex: Individual coaching and then straight to the Bublava charity ball, which aims to raise money from local businesses for the development of the village. After a series of performances by well-known…
beneficni-ples-podnikatelu-bublava.obsah:
Individual coaching and then straight to the Bublava charity ball, which aims to raise money from local businesses for the development of the village. After a series of performances by well-known artists, things needed livening up, so organiser Vláďa Keblůžek remembered Vlasta, who set off with Michal Budský to ride the local dance floor. It turned out to be the biggest obstacle, because it was really extra slippery.

Unfortunately the high jump was won by a guy from Prague who didn't like our classic joke about Praguers (even though Michal is from Prague too) and jumped highest over the tape. Thanks for the invitation and to everyone who came for your support.

dva-vikendy-plne-exhibic-a-kurzu.titulek: Two weekends full of exhibitions and courses
dva-vikendy-plne-exhibic-a-kurzu.perex: Last week was not only beautiful but also packed with work. On Thursday Lukáš Valný, Michal Budský and Vlasta rode an exhibition in eastern Bohemia for a pallet manufacturer at a private event. We…
dva-vikendy-plne-exhibic-a-kurzu.obsah:
Last week was not only beautiful but also packed with work. On Thursday Lukáš Valný, Michal Budský and Vlasta rode an exhibition in eastern Bohemia for a pallet manufacturer at a private event. We have no photos, but together with the stage there was a solid combo of pallet obstacles that the guys made full use of, and the Czech and foreign guests clearly enjoyed it. 

On Saturday Vlasta headed to a small village near Nymburk as a stand-in for Šimon, who was ill, and rode at a village event before a promotion football match for lots of locals. Although it didn't look like a big turnout at first, a great crowd gathered that really got the event going, and Vlasta came close to his old record in the jump over the tape.

Saturday and Sunday were all about individual courses – both small groups and young guns who want to move further.

---

Náměšť nad Oslavou hosted its traditional MTB marathon for young and grown-up riders. Part of our team came along too – Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Martin Šimůnek and Márty Kabeláč. Things went a bit downhill – not because of the performances or the crowd, but simply because the whole square was on a slope. We dealt with it, hopefully with honour, and nobody got hurt in either of our shows before the start and before the marathon awards ceremony. Congratulations to all riders on their performances.

Meanwhile Mára Tryner and Michal Budský were in picturesque Červená Voda, where a fair combined with a village festival took place, entertaining everyone in front of the main stage with our folding set of obstacles. Thanks to everyone for the invitation, and hopefully see you again sometime :)

otevirani-loucovicke-cyklostezky-loucovi.titulek: Opening of the Loučovice cycle path – Loučovice near Lipno
otevirani-loucovicke-cyklostezky-loucovi.perex: Lipno is a paradise for bikers and holidaymakers. Lukáš Valný and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček went to the opening of the local cycle path, which connects to an extensive network of trails around Lipno,…
otevirani-loucovicke-cyklostezky-loucovi.obsah:
Lipno is a paradise for bikers and holidaymakers. Lukáš Valný and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček went to the opening of the local cycle path, which connects to an extensive network of trails around Lipno, not only for bikers. Interesting surroundings, a live concert and spectators who love bikes. The ideal combination. On the way we also stopped at the Blindur races organised by Michal Prokop. When we can't make it as riders, at least we can be spectators for a moment :)

photo by #jelenvolevriji

trocha-campu-zavodeni-i-exhibic.titulek: A bit of camp, racing and exhibitions
trocha-campu-zavodeni-i-exhibic.perex: The last weekend of September was all about the camp, led by Marek Tryner for the men's group and Katarína Tóthová for women and girls. The weather looked terrible in the morning and the forecast was…
trocha-campu-zavodeni-i-exhibic.obsah:
The last weekend of September was all about the camp, led by Marek Tryner for the men's group and Katarína Tóthová for women and girls. The weather looked terrible in the morning and the forecast was wrong, but as the morning went on things turned into a sunny day, and in the end it looks like a successful end to the year. The day before the camp Vlasta focused on individual coaching and preparing the camp and the race held the following week.

The Czech Trial Zálesák Championship is a bit of a nod to the popular smaller Trial races of a few years ago, ridden under modified Openfree rules, and also a bit of a parody of today's Trial under the Czech Cycling Federation. Despite the rain a few enthusiasts gathered, and in the end 9 riders started in the adult category (compared to the 15 originally registered) plus a small kids' squad. The race took place at a secret forest spot that has been ridden for decades, but always only about once a year in dry conditions. In the wet it's a different league. The rules were adjusted to involve both rider performance and tactics. Simply so you had to think as well :) To everyone's surprise, the Elite 20” was won by Tobík Dolák, ahead of his guru Lukáš Valný and Pepa Neumann. In Elite 26” the win went to Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, ahead of Mára Tryner and Petr Jeřicha. The performance of the day came from Mára, who tried to wipe out Vlasta's lead and ended up taking a bit of a swim in the river, but it was a really interesting battle with crashes, slipping brakes and drama at the end. 

The day before the race, Vlasta, Lukáš Valný and guest rider Jířa Sehnal did an exhibition near Blansko, where unfortunately the first of them pulled his back. The exhibition was saved by Jirka Sehnal senior, who managed to bring the sound system – which was a bit further away than expected – in record time, and in the end the guys did a full 25 minutes of fooling around, which we hope the spectators enjoyed; they filled the whole space around the obstacles. Thanks for the invitation.

kalendar-bikeskills-2025.perex: This year too we have camps ready for everyone who wants to improve their basic and advanced bike technique. Limited places depending on our instructors. Proven and new locations offered by the…
kalendar-bikeskills-2025.obsah:
This year too we have camps ready for everyone who wants to improve their basic and advanced bike technique. Limited places depending on our instructors. Proven and new locations offered by the Říčany region and Central Bohemia.

We'll cover everything from body position on the bike, braking, descents, roots, trails and berms to riding over smaller obstacles you may encounter off-road.

For young riders we have a bike day camp in the Tehov leisure park and surrounding area.

3-exhibice-v-jeden-den-na-festivalech-a-.titulek: 3 exhibitions in one day at festivals and celebrations
3-exhibice-v-jeden-den-na-festivalech-a-.perex: Surprisingly, even during the summer holidays we sometimes don't know which way to jump. This time we were called to a festival in Hlásná Třebaň for the fire brigade, where there were some really…
3-exhibice-v-jeden-den-na-festivalech-a-.obsah:
Surprisingly, even during the summer holidays we sometimes don't know which way to jump. This time we were called to a festival in Hlásná Třebaň for the fire brigade, where there were some really incredibly interesting things to see from the people who protect us. There was even a motorbike riding over a car wreck, which was then cut up and set on fire as part of further rescue demonstrations. Before Třebaň we rode an event at Friendfest with Martin Šimůnek, who couldn't come with us to the next event because of a scheduling conflict and had to ride two shorter shows on his own. Friendfest also offered lots of interesting attractions, and we got to meet the guys from freestyle motocross (Podmol brothers), who were kind enough to lend us their sound system. Both shows were also ridden by Dalibor Šulc on a moto-trial bike and Vlasta Kabeláč with his kids' crew.

Meanwhile Marek Tryner and Michal Budský made a trip to Černčice near Louny, where a village festival celebrated 670 years since the first written mention of the village. 

We're collecting photos from all the events and hopefully everything will come together by the end of the summer holidays.

nataceni-tv-poradu-lvicata.titulek: Filming of the TV show Lvíčata
nataceni-tv-poradu-lvicata.perex: Once again our club took part in the TV show Lvíčata for boys and girls aged 8–12. This time we had the club hall in Nedvězí at our disposal, where more of us fitted in and the boys and girls could…
nataceni-tv-poradu-lvicata.obsah:
Once again our club took part in the TV show Lvíčata for boys and girls aged 8–12. This time we had the club hall in Nedvězí at our disposal, where more of us fitted in and the boys and girls could show what they're currently learning.

In a short tutorial, Marfy Gomboš Jr. and I tried to teach them some balance and hopping, which might come in handy. Then we gave them a peek into our training routine and the kids did a few interviews. It was clearly more stressful for me than for them :)

exhibice-a-workshop-bory.perex: On the way to the picturesque village of Bory, Vlasta and Šimon had picturesque rain and thunderstorms. Even while building the obstacles and the workshop it didn't look great. Luckily, just before…
exhibice-a-workshop-bory.obsah: On the way to the picturesque village of Bory, Vlasta and Šimon had picturesque rain and thunderstorms. Even while building the obstacles and the workshop it didn't look great. Luckily, just before the show the sun came out, so the guys could get the show going in front of the stage (the grass hadn't dried yet). The exhibition stretched to over 30 minutes and the spectators were great. There were volunteers (twice, in fact) and a competition. Afterwards a smaller workshop started, which was packed for the whole next hour, and the kids tried out what they'd seen in the exhibition on a smaller obstacle course.

ples-motocyklistu-vysoka.perex: The motorcyclists' ball near Mělník was genuine old-school fun in an old but well-preserved gym that looked like it came straight out of a film from the 70s/80s. Martin Šimůnek and Vlasta Kabeláč…
ples-motocyklistu-vysoka.obsah:
The motorcyclists' ball near Mělník was genuine old-school fun in an old but well-preserved gym that looked like it came straight out of a film from the 70s/80s. Martin Šimůnek and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček went along to entertain the locals.

It was also Martin's premiere on his new bike, as he returned to a 26” machine after 10 years. At the end of the almost 30-minute show, one more gauntlet was thrown down: ride down the stage and the obstacles on a Babeta moped :)

exhibice-hrusovany-pod-jevisovko-a-bikef.titulek: Exhibition in Hrušovany nad Jevišovkou and Bikefestival
exhibice-hrusovany-pod-jevisovko-a-bikef.perex: This weekend was a bit quieter, and part of our team was jumping for the kids and adults who came to the village festival in Hrušovany nad Jevišovkou. The picturesque village with a modern new sports…
exhibice-hrusovany-pod-jevisovko-a-bikef.obsah:
This weekend was a bit quieter, and part of our team was jumping for the kids and adults who came to the village festival in Hrušovany nad Jevišovkou. The picturesque village with a modern new sports hall and outdoor sports ground provided a great atmosphere. We were a bit taken aback by the incredible heat – it was almost 8 degrees warmer than in Prague and the surrounding area. 

We threw ourselves into training and, unfortunately, also into fixing some minor technical problems with the bikes. 

I think the locals understand sport, because the whole time we were there, apart from riding, we did nothing but sign cards and take photos with the local youngsters :)

Thanks for the invitation – the touring party: Vlasta, Lukáš Valný and Matouš Balík

On Sunday part of the team went looking for new trails in the Šembera valley. Sometimes you just need to switch off and take a moment for yourself on a full-suspension bike. Afterwards Vlasta and his family went to check out the promotion of the Říčanské Šlapačky Bikefestival. Thanks to Pavel Hájek's work, there was hardly a bike-related place without a poster or banner :)

cestlicky-pumptrack-otevren.perex: The municipality of Čestlice invited us to the opening of its pump track, with us providing the complete programme. The sound system, Trial exhibition and workshop were all on us. The Čestlice pump…
cestlicky-pumptrack-otevren.obsah:
The municipality of Čestlice invited us to the opening of its pump track, with us providing the complete programme.

The sound system, Trial exhibition and workshop were all on us. The Čestlice pump track is bigger than the ones in Stránčice or Nupaky and is fully asphalt. Our task was a roughly one-hour programme consisting of a Trial show and a pump track workshop together with Katarína and the guys from the club.

After us came a smaller exhibition on the workout playground. At first it didn't look like a big turnout, but in the end lots of spectators and riders gathered and rushed onto the pump track after the show.

srpen-ve-znameni-kurzu-i-exhibic.titulek: August full of courses and exhibitions
srpen-ve-znameni-kurzu-i-exhibic.perex: 1/8 – Village festival exhibition – Třtěnice Right after getting back from holiday, Vlasta packed the car, the trailer and his colleague Lukáš Valný and set off for Třtěnice to show the local boys…
srpen-ve-znameni-kurzu-i-exhibic.obsah:
1/8 – Village festival exhibition – Třtěnice

Right after getting back from holiday, Vlasta packed the car, the trailer and his colleague Lukáš Valný and set off for Třtěnice to show the local boys how to ride a bike over obstacles. At first it looked like rain, but luckily they have it all figured out in Třtěnice and we rode under a roof that fitted the trailer and the obstacles. The turnout wasn't bad and you could see they have a promising biking community there that cheered us on.

2, 4, 8, 9/8 – Coaching, coaching, coaching and a kids' camp – Říčany area

A series of individual lessons flowed into the preparation of our August kids' camp, which was blessed with good weather and a great group of boys who flew around like their lives depended on it. Unfortunately Vlasta, Lukáš and Mára couldn't take part in the camp directly because of work commitments, but Lukáš at least took care of the technical side of the event and Vlasta did a small exhibition for the kids and parents at the end. All the more we could watch how much the boys progressed in those few days under the guidance of Katarína Tóthová and Matěj Bedrník.

13/8 – Day camp exhibition – Prague Počernice

A fellow biker remembered seeing us at an exhibition and asked if we could show something to the kids at their camp. A group of young boys and girls in the middle of the forest at a gamekeeper's lodge, on bikes all week, already had a solid programme, so instead of a classic exhibition Vlasta did more of a workshop explaining technique – but there was a bit of hopping over obstacles too.

14, 15/8 – Exhibition at the chateau – Bílé Poličany

When a village celebrates 750 years, it knows how to go all out, so the local chateau and park actually became a festival of local clubs, concerts by Czech bands and other attractions. Martin Šimůnek, Čihi and Lukáš Valný got to entertain over 500 people in front of the main stage, and judging by the feedback it hopefully went well. It was great that a few former Trial riders (now bikers) came for a chat, and apparently it inspired them to maybe bring their Trial bikes back out into the light. We topped off the weekend with double individual coaching on the trails and in the Tehov park, and at an Enduro training session with Petr Jeřicha there was a chance to test the new POC Kortal helmet from Levelsportkoncept. Simply put, there was plenty going on in those two days.

tj-sokol-dynamo-moravany-ples.perex: Lukáš Valný, Tobík Dolák and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček accepted an invitation from the Sokol members of Moravany near Pardubice to their traditional ball. The dance floor was extra slippery, but…
tj-sokol-dynamo-moravany-ples.obsah: Lukáš Valný, Tobík Dolák and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček accepted an invitation from the Sokol members of Moravany near Pardubice to their traditional ball. The dance floor was extra slippery, but luckily we got through without a crash. A great crowd full of athletes, a caring organiser and a good mood gave the exhibition just the right dynamics. We rode the obstacles, a competition and jumps over volunteers. Thanks for the invitation – hopefully see you in the summer.

exhibice-galerie-ep1-umelecka-cyklovysta.titulek: EP1 gallery exhibition – cycling art show – Trutnov
exhibice-galerie-ep1-umelecka-cyklovysta.perex: Vlasta, Martin Šimůnek and Michal Budský accepted an invitation to perform at the opening of an exhibition of cycling-related art. We set up our trailer with the main obstacles at the main entrance…
exhibice-galerie-ep1-umelecka-cyklovysta.obsah: Vlasta, Martin Šimůnek and Michal Budský accepted an invitation to perform at the opening of an exhibition of cycling-related art. We set up our trailer with the main obstacles at the main entrance and threw ourselves into our show. It was great to meet several former Trial riders and bikers there, who motivated us to perform even better. The exhibition was also very interesting and creative, as were the gallery spaces themselves, which we definitely recommend visiting.

exhibice-zdikov-jirikovice-kovanice-kolo.titulek: Exhibitions in Zdíkov, Jiříkovice, Kovanice and Kolovraty
exhibice-zdikov-jirikovice-kovanice-kolo.perex: A series of exhibitions at children's days is almost a tradition at the start of the season. Matouš Balík and Michal Budský headed to Jiříkovice near Brno. Vlasta and Lukáš Valný went towards 'Sun,…
exhibice-zdikov-jirikovice-kovanice-kolo.obsah:
A series of exhibitions at children's days is almost a tradition at the start of the season. Matouš Balík and Michal Budský headed to Jiříkovice near Brno. Vlasta and Lukáš Valný went towards 'Sun, Hay, Strawberries' country (hopefully everyone gets it), where the event took place in the local gym because of the weather. From there they moved a few hundred kilometres to Kovanice north of Prague, where the spectators were already in full swing, and with reinforcement Tobík Dolák they rode a show by the local playground.

The next day a bigger children's day took place in the nearby Prague district of Kolovraty, where together with our Kabeláč kids' squad, Martínek Gomboš and of course Tobík Dolák we completed a rainy marathon of alternating showers and sunshine. Fortunately at least part of the exhibition stayed dry and everyone survived in good health – except for Vlasta's throat, as he hosted without a microphone :)

akce-v-cervenci-jsou-za-nami.titulek: Half of the July events are behind us
akce-v-cervenci-jsou-za-nami.perex: 10/7 – Movomal 2021 exhibition – Mariánské Lázně A beautiful day, a big event and female company too. The ideal weekend exhibition right in the centre of Mariánské Lázně at Movomal 2021, the first…
akce-v-cervenci-jsou-za-nami.obsah:
10/7 – Movomal 2021 exhibition – Mariánské Lázně

A beautiful day, a big event and female company too. The ideal weekend exhibition right in the centre of Mariánské Lázně at Movomal 2021, the first event held after Covid-19. Lukáš Valný came along with Vlasta, and in two shows on our trailer they showed a few hundred spectators what can be done on a bike. The organisers praised us, and the spectators' reactions made it clear they were enjoying the day and the show. The only pity was that we couldn't stay for the afternoon too, but the wedding of Petr Jeřicha from our team and club simply took priority.

12–16/7 – Organising a bike day camp – Tehov

The second edition of our bike day camps, created under the banner of our club and the Bikeskills.cz project, will run in two sessions this time. The first July session is behind us, again with plenty of bike-hungry girls and boys who did nothing all day but fly around on bikes on the jumps, the pump track or on rides around the area. The rain complicated things a bit, but in the end it didn't turn out badly and the rain always stopped within a few hours. We also had alternative food in the form of flavoured gummy worms, and there were chess tournaments too.

17/7 – Dolánky festival exhibition – Dolánky near Turnov

We always look forward to a show with our legendary member Martin Šimůnek. The line-up was strong, we brought two trailers of obstacles and prepared a workshop. In the end it rained so much that we didn't even get the bikes out of the car, and we were glad the organiser let us go home, because the whole Liberec region was completely under water. It was probably the first exhibition where we didn't ride at all because of rain :( Hopefully we'll get a chance to show what we can do in slightly better conditions.

19/7 – LSK days – Prague

After his vaccination, but with the prospect of testing the Jahodnice bike park, Vlasta headed to the open days of Levelsportkoncept, which he has been working with for… well, a long time. The importer of POC, MALOJA, Lezyne, DVO and many other exclusive brands invites its employees and partners to a reception. Unfortunately Vlasta only had time for one day, so a test of Jahodnice was arranged, which was built by Michal Maroši, another LSK rider. There was playing around on the skills centre, the pump track was tested and a few attempts on the jumps too. Thanks for the invitation – we look forward to the next ride.

dva-tymy-a-dve-akce-zadverice-a-milikov.titulek: Two teams and two events – Zádveřice and Milíkov
dva-tymy-a-dve-akce-zadverice-a-milikov.perex: On Saturday we had to split our team into two separate units. Martin Šimůnek and Matouš Balík headed to Milíkov to ride an exhibition and run a small workshop for the kids. Vlasta, Marek Tryner and…
dva-tymy-a-dve-akce-zadverice-a-milikov.obsah:
On Saturday we had to split our team into two separate units. Martin Šimůnek and Matouš Balík headed to Milíkov to ride an exhibition and run a small workshop for the kids. 

Vlasta, Marek Tryner and Katarína Tóthová, on the other hand, headed to Zádveřice, which was really packed with spectators and side programme. An accident on the motorway caused a delay, but the organiser forgave us and the guys did a solid job. They even earned a parcel of frgál cakes and refreshments for the workshop, which took place on the local asphalt pump track and jumps under Katarína's guidance.

primestsky-tabor-no-1.perex: The Tehov park hosted another day camp organised by Bikeskills and the MTB Trial Mraveniště club. The organising team has been stable for a few years now and instructors Katarína and Matěj know their…
primestsky-tabor-no-1.obsah:
The Tehov park hosted another day camp organised by Bikeskills and the MTB Trial Mraveniště club. The organising team has been stable for a few years now and instructors Katarína and Matěj know their job. Carers Lucka and Lenka fill the free time and treat any injuries that turn up.

This year a decent bunch of young guns of both sexes came together. The progress was really noticeable – unfortunately at the cost of two injuries (a split eyebrow and a concussion), which is part of riding bikes. Fortunately everything ended well with no lasting consequences. The weather was ideal and the kids managed everything physically too. Vlasta organised a small training session for the Trial riders taking part and, the next day, a somewhat more extreme ride for the older boys.

foceni-a-exhibice-o-destivem-vikendu.titulek: Photo shoot and exhibitions on a rainy weekend
foceni-a-exhibice-o-destivem-vikendu.perex: We are currently processing photos from the shoot of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček's new bike, taken by Říčany photo legend Ruda Flachs. In dust, sweat and mosquitoes they completed a shoot that will…
foceni-a-exhibice-o-destivem-vikendu.obsah:
We are currently processing photos from the shoot of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček's new bike, taken by Říčany photo legend Ruda Flachs. In dust, sweat and mosquitoes they completed a shoot that will gradually be posted on social media.

For our team the weekend was all about exhibitions and holidays. Martin Šimůnek was performing in Hradec Králové and Vlasta with Lukáš Valný in Rumburk. Both days it was absolutely pouring…, but huge respect to the organisers who carried on, and all the events went ahead. Sometimes you just have to ride in the wet.

We have a few photos in the gallery, but nothing to write home about.

otevirali-jsme-pumptrack-v-brandyse.titulek: We opened the pump track in Brandýs
otevirali-jsme-pumptrack-v-brandyse.perex: Our projects Trialshow.cz and Bikeskills.cz were invited to the opening of a luxury pump track in Brandýs. The main part of the programme was an exhibition by our team – Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček,…
otevirali-jsme-pumptrack-v-brandyse.obsah:
Our projects Trialshow.cz and Bikeskills.cz were invited to the opening of a luxury pump track in Brandýs. 

The main part of the programme was an exhibition by our team – Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Lukáš Valný and Matouš Balík – with guest Ondra Nenadál from our club. 

The workshop with coaching for kids and adults was run by Katarína Tóthová with the family teams of the Hlouchas and Kabeláčs and all the riders from our club who had a moment to come, cheer and ride.

A nice turnout of spectators filled the pump track and the space around the obstacles. Everyone rode like their lives depended on it, and it was great to see kids and parents enjoying testing the pump track as well as our exhibition.

nove-u-nas-naleznete-znacku-ethirteen.titulek: E*thirteen is now available from us
nove-u-nas-naleznete-znacku-ethirteen.perex: E*thirteen is a world leader in products focused on mountain bike chain retention. Besides chain guides, its range also includes wheels, hubs, seatposts, cassettes, chainrings and much more. Our…

E*thirteen is a world leader in products focused on mountain bike chain retention. Besides chain guides, its range also includes wheels, hubs, seatposts, cassettes, chainrings and much more.

Find out more on the manufacturer's website, or jump straight to our e-shop. To start with, we have a 10% discount (or on request) for all enthusiasts who want to pimp their bike.

ples-zemedelske-university-v-praze.titulek: Czech University of Life Sciences Prague ball
ples-zemedelske-university-v-praze.perex: A 'small' ball with 2,000 guests was organised by students of the Czech University of Life Sciences (CZU) in Prague. They thought they'd like something a bit edgier and called our team to come…
ples-zemedelske-university-v-praze.obsah:
A 'small' ball with 2,000 guests was organised by students of the Czech University of Life Sciences (CZU) in Prague.

They thought they'd like something a bit edgier and called our team to come along. Vlasta and Luky packed the obstacles and launched a show in the main hall for a great audience. Admittedly, volunteers were hard to find given the formal dress, but a few brave souls came forward. Luky had a few technical problems, but everything was handled and the exhibition went as it should. Thanks to the organisers for the invitation and the hospitality.

exhibice-sokol-cyrilometodejsky-den-obec.titulek: Sokol exhibition, Saints Cyril and Methodius Day, Radonice village festival, day camp, …
exhibice-sokol-cyrilometodejsky-den-obec.perex: July is slowly coming to an end and we have a lot of work behind us. Besides lots of group and individual lessons, we also had our traditional week-long day camp. Once again it was fully booked, and this time it attracted practically only boys and girls who can already do something on a bike and want to move forward. It's great that they keep coming back to us over the years. Just before the camp we had an exhibition marathon: Dolní Kalná (exhibition for Sokol), Oucmanice (Saints Cyril and Methodius Day) and Radonice near Kadaň (village festival), where a pretty decent number of spectators gathered. exhibice-sokol-cyrilometodejsky-den-obec.obsah:
July is slowly coming to an end and we have a lot of work behind us. Besides lots of group and individual lessons, we also had our traditional week-long day camp. Once again it was fully booked, and this time it attracted practically only boys and girls who can already do something on a bike and want to move forward. It's great that they keep coming back to us over the years. Just before the camp we had an exhibition marathon: Dolní Kalná (exhibition for Sokol), Oucmanice (Saints Cyril and Methodius Day) and Radonice near Kadaň (village festival), where a pretty decent number of spectators gathered. Almost the whole team took part in the shows – Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Martin Šimůnek, Marek Tryner, Lukáš Valný and Michal Budský. During the month Vlasta also popped over to the Slovak Cup to act as a riding coach for the club kids at a successful local event in Veľké Zálužie, and filmed a short e-bike video with Katarína Tóthová. Individual E-MTB courses have also taken off, and it's great that whole groups of friends come together whom we can take around the area.


Next month we have one or more exhibitions every weekend, so hopefully the weather holds and we'll see you there.

bikeskills-camp-mix-2.perex: On Mother's Day we organised a Mix camp for everyone interested in technique. The weather worked out, so a group of male and female bikers could take on both our coaching and everything we put in…
bikeskills-camp-mix-2.obsah:
On Mother's Day we organised a Mix camp for everyone interested in technique. The weather worked out, so a group of male and female bikers could take on both our coaching and everything we put in their way. This time Katarína Tóthová and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček chose easier locations that could suit all riders. We managed to cover the basics as well as a few more advanced techniques. We were a little surprised by our afternoon return to the Tehov leisure park, which was packed – finding a free spot on the pump track was really hard. 

For Vlasta it was also his first camp on the CUBE e-bike he was issued, and since one of the participants was riding electric too, it came in handy as a demonstration of everything you can do on an e-bike.

bikeskills-campy-no-1-2.perex: We have our first two Bikeskills camps behind us, held over the weekend in Tehov and the surrounding area. Attendance was affected by lots of cancellations due to illness, which hit those around us…
bikeskills-campy-no-1-2.obsah: We have our first two Bikeskills camps behind us, held over the weekend in Tehov and the surrounding area. Attendance was affected by lots of cancellations due to illness, which hit those around us too. We mostly covered the basics and fine-tuned body position, and the women rode the pump track a lot. The men's group focused more on drops and benches. The weather was kind to us and there were very few crashes. Hopefully our coaching will give riders more confidence for the coming season. Riders who cancelled were moved to further camps and individual coaching.

sedm-statecnych-napric-republikou.titulek: The magnificent seven across the country
sedm-statecnych-napric-republikou.perex: We had plenty of work over the weekend. Part of the team led by Lukáš Valný headed to Moravia for a cycling day in Libhošť, where Matouš Balík, Tobík Dolák and Lukáš showed what they could at a…
sedm-statecnych-napric-republikou.obsah: We had plenty of work over the weekend. Part of the team led by Lukáš Valný headed to Moravia for a cycling day in Libhošť, where Matouš Balík, Tobík Dolák and Lukáš showed what they could at a smaller event for cycling enthusiasts. Martin Šimůnek, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Dalibor Šulc and Marty Kabeláč, meanwhile, were in Dolní Poustevna celebrating the Village of the Year, which was full of concerts and programmes for kids and adults. In two shows we presented a combination of a motorbike, a mountain bike, a smaller 24" bike and kids' Trial. Because of the space we used fewer obstacles, but it was still packed, the spectators cheered like crazy and egged us on to a few bigger jumps.

holky-ladi-bikeskills-camp-report.titulek: Women Tune Up with Bikeskills camp report
holky-ladi-bikeskills-camp-report.perex: We've organised day camps and we train men, but women were somewhat missing from our portfolio. Together with Katarína Tóthová we prepared a camp exclusively for the fairer sex – though I'd probably…
holky-ladi-bikeskills-camp-report.obsah:
We've organised day camps and we train men, but women were somewhat missing from our portfolio. Together with Katarína Tóthová we prepared a camp exclusively for the fairer sex – though I'd probably start calling them something else. Although registration again opened only a few weeks in advance, 10 brave Amazons signed up who wanted to improve their riding technique, and even learn how to repair a bike.

The whole morning was devoted to basic technique, riding over sleepers, body position on the bike, the pump track (i.e. rollers and berms) and the trail in our park. Then we moved to the popular Říčany restaurant Na Jurečku to refuel and rehydrate. And after lunch it was straight out into the terrain for descents, roots and even a hint of dropping.

We have to take our hats off to everyone, because on the same terrain many men would at least hesitate or get off the bike. They simply went for it with heart and encouragement.  After returning to the park there was a final workshop by Mára Tryner focused on bike repair and maintenance, and a look at the MALOJA 2021 collection.

Thanks to everyone for taking part – we'll answer questions about the next date within a few days :)

primestsky-tabor-tehov.perex: After a year we once again held a bike day camp. Putting the team together took relatively long, but in the end we assembled a great group of bikers and leaders who prepared an interesting five days…
primestsky-tabor-tehov.obsah:
After a year we once again held a bike day camp. Putting the team together took relatively long, but in the end we assembled a great group of bikers and leaders who prepared an interesting five days on the bike for more than 27 boys and girls. The weather was against us at first, but a proper biker rides in all weathers. Honza Havránek could tell you all about that as a downhiller. Michal Budský as a Trial rider would have a harder time, but he is a versatile rider with experience across several disciplines. The guys also had young guns Tobík and Dan, who helped with everything our capable leaders Lenka and Klárka needed. Vlasta was in charge of preparation, building, Trial training and a few other small things. 

The riders were skilful and there wasn't a single one who didn't improve. A competition every day, the occasional small crash (luckily nothing serious) and enthusiasm for riding from all the boys and girls.

Thank you for the feedback from parents and kids – hopefully we'll manage to organise another edition.

Photo by Mr Větrovec
