We are honoured that from 3 to 5 July we will be looking after young riders at the MTB Trilogy stage race as part of our new project Bikeskills.cz. If you are interested in technique coaching, don't hesitate to contact the event organisers directly. Of course this also applies to those who want to have fun in Enduro, XC and other disciplines.

You'll find more information on their website MTB Trilogy …

27-28-5-campy-bikeskills-a-exhibice-v-la.titulek: 27–28/5 – Bikeskills camps and an exhibition at the spa
27-28-5-campy-bikeskills-a-exhibice-v-la.perex: Saturday for female bikers and Sunday for male bikers. Beautiful weather and enthusiasm for coaching gave Katarína Tóthová on Saturday, and Vlasta with Mára Tryner on Sunday, the ideal weapon for…
27-28-5-campy-bikeskills-a-exhibice-v-la.obsah:
Saturday for female bikers and Sunday for male bikers. Beautiful weather and enthusiasm for coaching gave Katarína Tóthová on Saturday, and Vlasta with Mára Tryner on Sunday, the ideal weapon for pushing the limits of the riders who came. On Saturday the women rode literally flat out and apparently even flew over the handlebars (luckily without injury). On Sunday we also rode harder trails, and hopefully both the Enduro and XC guys were happy. Everyone rode their own lines, as far as their head and bike allowed.  

For Lukáš Valný and Vlasta, Saturday also included a trip to the beautiful surroundings of the Jáchymov spa, where the springs were being christened. A rich programme, crowds of spectators and great weather. The organisers won the lottery, and although we couldn't use our full obstacle setup because of space, we gave it everything to make the spectators' day better. Martin Šimůnek also rode a few Moravian exhibitions, including the felling of the maypole in Rouské, and workshops.

krteni-motorek-a-jilove-u-decina.titulek: Motorbike blessing and Jílové near Děčín
krteni-motorek-a-jilove-u-decina.perex: 7/5 – Exhibition and workshop in Jílové near Děčín – Motorbike blessing Martin Šimůnek and Lukáš Valný set off to Jílové near Děčín for the annual motorbike blessing. Their job wasn't just to jump…
krteni-motorek-a-jilove-u-decina.obsah:
7/5 – Exhibition and workshop in Jílové near Děčín – Motorbike blessing

Martin Šimůnek and Lukáš Valný set off to Jílové near Děčín for the annual motorbike blessing. Their job wasn't just to jump for crowds of kids and adult spectators, but also to run our workshop, where everyone could test how good they are at riding over obstacles and their technique. Martin once again showed his quality as a host – and that he matures like wine with age. The organisers' thanks are always nice, and thank you for the invitation.

7/5 – Exhibition in Horní Maršov, Krkonoše

Horní Maršov was dominated by two experienced riders: Petr Jeřicha, who focuses mainly on Enduro due to a back injury, but whose Trial title still shows. Together with Michal Budský, who rides a street bike, they alone would probably have been enough for the organisers – but why not show the young ones how riders their own age ride? Matouš Balík is a new member of our team and a young gun in the club at junior level. Despite being in the middle of his school-leaving exams, he went with Petr and Michal to gain experience and ride with legends of the Trial sport. Here too we received positive feedback from the organisers, and we thank them for the invitation and the great atmosphere.

reporty-z-exhibic-a-workshopu-z-posledni.titulek: Reports from exhibitions and workshops over the last two weekends
reporty-z-exhibic-a-workshopu-z-posledni.perex: 17/5 – Cycling day exhibition – Droužkovice A small village in the north held a cycling day, and our team – Lukáš Valný, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and kids from the club – was invited too.…
reporty-z-exhibic-a-workshopu-z-posledni.obsah:
17/5 – Cycling day exhibition – Droužkovice

A small village in the north held a cycling day, and our team – Lukáš Valný, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and kids from the club – was invited too. Unfortunately the weather was a bit harsher, and the temperature with the possibility of a storm didn't attract many spectators. Anyway, a few true believers came, so we could show them a bit of Trial riding over obstacles, and after the exhibition Vlasta tried some gaps onto a tree trunk and the local walls in the grounds.

31/5 – Triple exhibition – all over the Czech Republic

Storms wherever you looked, but a pleasant temperature. We played roulette all over the Czech Republic. Near Jablůnkov, Lukáš Valný and Michal Budský started their exhibition at the edge of a storm cloud, but everything went as it should. Martin Šimůnek took his workshop to Moravia, where he managed to ride part of the programme before the rest was unfortunately washed out. And the biggest group – Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and the kids, Marek Tryner as host and Tobík Dolák as workshop instructor – headed to Most. Unfortunately, due to a knee injury, Mára is having ligament surgery in a few days, and Tobík Dolák overdid his training enthusiasm and found out what it's like to land on your tailbone from height. So the riding was on Vlasta and the kids, followed by a workshop on Trial bikes and obstacles. Luckily the weather turned out ideal, so mission accomplished on all fronts.

exhibice-obecni-slavnosti-dolni-rasnice.titulek: Village festival exhibition in Dolní Řasnice
exhibice-obecni-slavnosti-dolni-rasnice.perex: A demanding first exhibition after injury for Vlasta, and also for the other riders, who had to cope with the extreme heat at the event in picturesque Řasnice. We were a bit surprised by an almost…
exhibice-obecni-slavnosti-dolni-rasnice.obsah:
A demanding first exhibition after injury for Vlasta, and also for the other riders, who had to cope with the extreme heat at the event in picturesque Řasnice. We were a bit surprised by an almost hour-long traffic jam on the way to Liberec, which delayed other performers at the event too. 

The locals were already in full swing when we arrived, and the mayor welcomed us in full gear. On the gravel surface we had a carpet ready to ride on. Lukáš Valný, Vlasta and young guns Márty, Elli and Nikol launched into the exhibition, which entertained the spectators hiding in the tent, and several of them didn't mind playing living obstacles in the sun. 

Thanks for the invitation and the encouragement.

posledni-letosni-campy-bikeskills.perex: This weekend we ran the last Bikeskills weekend camps. Both the women's and men's camps brought together a decent group of riders who wanted to improve and progress – each within their own…
posledni-letosni-campy-bikeskills.obsah:
This weekend we ran the last Bikeskills weekend camps. Both the women's and men's camps brought together a decent group of riders who wanted to improve and progress – each within their own abilities, of course.

After the morning basics, pump track, berms and – for the men – jumps, we moved to the nearby Marvánek swimming pool for lunch and then along our traditional route, where we have various technical spots ready, from drops and Trial to descents for riders of all levels. 

Many thanks to all participants for their effort, their patience with our explanations and the appreciation at the end. Hopefully Vlasta, Katarína and Matouš passed something on to you.

Women:

Men

bikefestival-ricanske-slapacky-2022.perex: The traditional event organised by the MTB & Trial Mraveniště Říčany club under the leadership of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček has grown somewhat since Pavel Hájek (former manager of the FORBIKES trade fair) joined.
bikefestival-ricanske-slapacky-2022.obsah:
The traditional event organised by the MTB & Trial Mraveniště Říčany club under the leadership of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček has grown somewhat since Pavel Hájek (former manager of the FORBIKES trade fair) joined. This year the programme was expanded, the event returned to a two-day format (as in the days of hosting international UCI C1 races) and an Expo zone was added.

Big plans, demanding preparation – but the fate of outdoor events is always the roulette called weather. Šlapačky really got a taste of it this year. On the Monday before the race a storm arrived that completely destroyed the Tehov pump track. Thanks to the municipality of Tehov and Michal Maroši, a group of people was found who restored it almost to its original state, which – had it lasted – would have guaranteed a beautifully groomed track. Unfortunately, on Friday evening and practically all of Saturday all hell broke loose in Říčany and Tehov. The rain only stopped late on Saturday afternoon. The pump track was again practically half destroyed. But every event organiser knows you have to fight for success. So repairs to the pump track went on late into the night, with the promised warmer, sunny Sunday in prospect. Fortunately, it came.

Practically most of Saturday's disciplines were moved to Sunday in a limited form. First to start was the rescheduled kids' Trial race, where spectators could admire the art of overcoming obstacles performed by the youngest kids from the club and guests. The race was ridden under modified rules that motivate riders to complete the whole section more than the current official rules do. 

Because of the schedule the race was run quickly, and some riders could jump straight into the kids' MTB XC races, which were very physically demanding as the terrain slowly dried out. Parents cheered and the kids didn't give away a centimetre. The difficulty was reflected in the number of riders who gave up in the high humidity and heat – but hats off to them for finding the courage to race in these conditions.

Next came the adults' Trial exhibition race, which was something of a Trial celebration. Four generations of Trial riders faced each other in one race. Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, 10-time Czech Elite champion, against his master, multiple world champion Martin Šimůnek, who after almost 10 years of riding exhibitions tried racing again. As if that weren't enough, local native, Czech champion and Vlasta's student Petr Jeřicha also returned after 5 years. The circle was completed by Matouš Balík, Lukáš Valný and other guys from the club. Victory across all course difficulties went to Petr Jeřicha ahead of Martin and Vlasta. The latter took the win in the Elite category and the Trial record. The bunny hop contest was won by Lukáš Valný.

While the adults' Trial was still going, training started on the pump track, which had dried a little. Pump track training had to be banned all morning. Conditions were the same for all riders, and although the track was slow and physically demanding, there were lots of great performances in the battles for fat prize money, trophies and medals.

This year more than 115 riders started at the event, lots of fans came, and even more were unfortunately put off by the weather. You'll be able to watch footage from the event on ČT Déčko, or on the Trialshow and Bikeskills team YouTube channels once the edit is finished. 

We look forward to seeing you at next year's edition – hopefully the weather order will work out this time..

chlapy-na-campu-si-uzili-dest-i-slunicko.titulek: The men at camp enjoyed both rain and sunshine
chlapy-na-campu-si-uzili-dest-i-slunicko.perex: This year's first camp for men was very much about May drizzle. The forecast was completely off – when it was supposed to be sunny it rained, and vice versa. Anyway, it wasn't a downpour, and a…
chlapy-na-campu-si-uzili-dest-i-slunicko.obsah:
This year's first camp for men was very much about May drizzle. The forecast was completely off – when it was supposed to be sunny it rained, and vice versa. Anyway, it wasn't a downpour, and a classic windbreaker kept everyone alive and at a reasonable operating temperature.

As it was an intermediate camp, it was clear we'd tackle harder things. After the morning classics in the Tehov park we went straight to the descents in the former quarry, where a few tricky muddy, rocky lines run. In the end everyone found their limit, and more than one die-hard who couldn't resist temptation ended up on their side on the slope. Fortunately there were no serious injuries or trips to hospital, and in the end everyone outdid themselves and hopefully took away something useful from the camp for the trails and the future..

Now just repeat, train and try :) Hopefully see you again at a men's camp during/after the summer holidays.

evropsky-den-bez-aut.perex: A traditional exhibition date is European Car-Free Day, when our team is fully booked. This year the fastest to book were the organisers in Štětí and in Prague. Lukáš Valný, Marek Tryner and,…
evropsky-den-bez-aut.obsah:
A traditional exhibition date is European Car-Free Day, when our team is fully booked. This year the fastest to book were the organisers in Štětí and in Prague. Lukáš Valný, Marek Tryner and, somewhat unplanned, Matouš Balík rode together at Náměstí Republiky in Prague, enjoying a beautiful sunny day.

Vlasta and Martin Šimůnek, on the other hand, had slightly gloomy weather, but still pleasant riding on the square in Štětí, where kids from local schools came along. 

Both events were also workshops where kids could borrow Trial and regular MTB bikes to try out.

ples-spolku-obci-v-ceprovicich.titulek: Ball of the association of municipalities in Čepřovice
ples-spolku-obci-v-ceprovicich.perex: We received an invitation from Čepřovice near Strakonice, where a ball of 6 municipalities was being held. Nothing was left to chance – the organiser booked us back in January, so we were free and…
ples-spolku-obci-v-ceprovicich.obsah:
We received an invitation from Čepřovice near Strakonice, where a ball of 6 municipalities was being held. Nothing was left to chance – the organiser booked us back in January, so we were free and the team of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Lukáš Valný could head to the event. Besides the mayor, we also had kids on hand, who gave us great support. The atmosphere was lively, as is usual at village balls, and from among the sportsmen and sportswomen we chose a few volunteers who weren't afraid to lie down under our bikes. Thanks for the invitation – hopefully see you at an exhibition or workshop next year.

Sorry for the lower photo quality – we only managed to get a video, from which they were created.

trial-a-pump-jam-tehov.perex: Our farewell to the Tehov park before winter – and hopefully its spring rebuild – in the form of small races and training was moved a bit. There was a risk that few riders would come because of the…
trial-a-pump-jam-tehov.obsah:
Our farewell to the Tehov park before winter – and hopefully its spring rebuild – in the form of small races and training was moved a bit. There was a risk that few riders would come because of the long weekend, but in the end the turnout was a surprise. About 20 riders started in Trial and a similar number on the pump track, which is about half of the club's members. The weather was for tougher characters – alternately muddy, but without rain – but the kids didn't mind and the adult riders survived too 🙂

As every year, the rules were based on OPEN FREE, with riders choosing the arrows they want to ride and the difficulty. Categories were divided by age and, for older riders, by riders. Each rider had to adapt the course to themselves with a limit of 5–6 arrows per section. Riding was in groups, each with its own judge, who could also adjust the rules to suit the riders. 

It was great that a few club legends who don't normally come to training showed up too. Michal Havránek got up from his director's chair, saddled his blue Ozonys and battled more with his physical fitness – which, as he said, he needs to catch up on – than with the bike. Martin Šimůnek rode his last big event on a 24” before switching to 26”, on which he won a number of world titles, and he really surprised in his duel with Míra Brunclík. Honestly, doing gaps onto around 10–11 pallets in the mud after turning 50 is insane, and on one of the sections in the first round Míra and Martin even managed to beat Mára and Vlasta. At the other end of the age spectrum, a Martin also cleverly took 3rd place – but this one from the Gomboš family.

The rules were very much about using your head and thinking, so even a rider weaker in jumping or performance could beat a more experienced one if they attempted harder arrows – and the results showed it. 5 riders entered on 20” bikes and the same number on 26”. Tobík Dolák won Elite 20” just ahead of his 20-inch guru Valňák, and Vlasta battled Mára Tryner for first place on the 26-inch bikes.

The pump track followed straight after, so the Trial riders had time to change clothes and bikes. After a few practice runs, the youngest riders on balance bikes started, and then it went all the way up to the fastest adults.

The finale was all about tidying up and sausages.

galavecer-bigmat.perex: We were invited to the expo of BIGMAT, one of the big supporters of the UCI World Cups, which wanted to show its employees and partners a bit of cycling. They chose our team, for which we thank them.…
galavecer-bigmat.obsah:
We were invited to the expo of BIGMAT, one of the big supporters of the UCI World Cups, which wanted to show its employees and partners a bit of cycling. They chose our team, for which we thank them. The bit of time pressure didn't throw us, we fitted into the space and didn't destroy any of the expensive lasers and LED screens. This time we didn't use our traditional obstacles but stylishly rode on classic pallets, and Vlasta even put on a BigMat T-shirt. He was backed up by Marek Tryner in his first exhibition after his knee injury, Tobík Dolák, who ended up as a volunteer, and Lukáš Valný, who for the first time in his life experienced a technical problem during an exhibition, when his chain snapped after maybe the first 3 jumps on a brand-new bike. Not a great advert for that X9 range.

Thanks for the invitation and the luxurious photos and video.

vikendove-campy-pro-holky-i-chlapy.titulek: Weekend camps for women and men
vikendove-campy-pro-holky-i-chlapy.perex: This weekend was full not only of exhibitions but also of camps. On Saturday women and girls developed their skills. Sunday was devoted to men. The weather was probably more pleasant for the ladies.…
vikendove-campy-pro-holky-i-chlapy.obsah:
This weekend was full not only of exhibitions but also of camps. On Saturday women and girls developed their skills. Sunday was devoted to men.

The weather was probably more pleasant for the ladies. It didn't rain, but let's be honest – it was cold. A really wide range of female bikers came together, but each found her own thing. Basic technique, balance, the pump track and berms were just the start. Gradually the women also took on smaller drops, steps and benches.

From the men, riding in occasional rain (fortunately it only rained for about an hour of net time), we expected a bit of respect. In the park it was a bit of a struggle, but in the forest they showed they weren't afraid to step out of their own shadow. They handled drops into gullies, a double and a few rooty descents with confidence.

We hope everyone moved forward a bit and found out what to work on and practise. During the camps there was already talk of buying new bikes, changing pedals and buying protectors. Thanks also to everyone for the positive feedback on the spot – we'll look forward to any further camps or individual coaching.

A few photos from Katarína below; the rest, including videos, we're sending directly to the participants.

Besides the camps, our team riders were also busy at exhibitions in Svojetice and Lomnice nad Lužnicí – an ideally filled weekend for most of our riders :)

exhibice-a-workshop-svatomichelske-slavn.titulek: Exhibition and workshop at the St Michael's Festival in Litvínov
exhibice-a-workshop-svatomichelske-slavn.perex: The town of Litvínov invited us to its traditional St Michael's Festival, which takes place at several locations in this beautifully developing town. Our exhibition and workshop were in the centre of…
exhibice-a-workshop-svatomichelske-slavn.obsah:
The town of Litvínov invited us to its traditional St Michael's Festival, which takes place at several locations in this beautifully developing town. Our exhibition and workshop were in the centre of the sports zones in the local chateau park, right opposite the mobile stage. Unfortunately, as soon as we arrived it was clear that Vlasta, Martin and Matouš were in for a tough time. Rain, rain and a temperature you wouldn't send a dog out in. There was nothing to do but set everything up and wait until the afternoon to see if spectators would come. 

The spectators came – and so did the rain. The guys and participants fought bravely, and even in total rain the workshop ran at full speed. We had to change the exhibition plan, and the first show took place on the stage, where Martin Šimůnek dared to jump even on the wet, slippery surface. 

About an hour later the sun peeked out for a moment, and Vlasta and Matouš got their bikes out to jump for the local TV crew. Vlasta then did a small demonstration on the stage and the jumps over the tape, finishing a little above 125 cm, which isn't bad at all given the conditions. Matouš warmed up on the obstacles, with the only condition being that he couldn't jump down to the ground, which was one big mud bath. He warmed up nicely, even with the spectators' support, but at the moment of the real exhibition what came? ….. A total cloudburst, which was also the end of this event. We simply did our best, the organiser thanked us and so did the spectators for our courage. Thanks for the invitation – and next year without rain.

oteviracka-bikepark-jahodnice-praha.titulek: Opening of the Jahodnice bike park – Prague
oteviracka-bikepark-jahodnice-praha.perex: We opened the Prague mini bike park in Jahodnice, where the local kiosk was also opening. The exhibition by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Lukáš Valný and the little ones from the club attracted lots of…
oteviracka-bikepark-jahodnice-praha.obsah: We opened the Prague mini bike park in Jahodnice, where the local kiosk was also opening. The exhibition by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Lukáš Valný and the little ones from the club attracted lots of spectators, who also came to ride the pump track, skills centre and jumps. After the show we joined in and tested how demanding the local jumps are – not exactly small for full-suspension bikes. Our sound system was used at the event and we signed a few autographs for local riders. Thanks for the invitation

naloz-4-exhibic-napric-republikou.titulek: A load of 4 exhibitions across the country
naloz-4-exhibic-napric-republikou.perex: Teplice – Sports Games for the Disabled Our travelling marathon of exhibitions started on Wednesday at the sports games for athletes with disabilities, right away with full firepower of 4 Trial bike…
naloz-4-exhibic-napric-republikou.obsah:
Teplice – Sports Games for the Disabled

Our travelling marathon of exhibitions started on Wednesday at the sports games for athletes with disabilities, right away with full firepower of 4 Trial bike riders (Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Matouš Balík, Lukáš Pařízek and Tobík Nenadál as the youngest of the group) plus Dalibor Šulc as a moto-trial rider. The athletes with disabilities ranged from 18 to over 80 years old and were a truly great and grateful audience that appreciated every attempt the guys made. It was great to bring them a little joy and experiences, of which they had plenty at this event thanks to a great organising team.

Mělník – STATECH exhibition

One of this year's first corporate events, at the open days of Statech (forklifts and aerial work platforms), was led by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Martin Šimůnek. There was even jumping over a platform, which surprised the guys when they found out that, when extended, it isn't quite as stable as you'd expect :) Jumping down from it was a bit of a challenge, but Martin Šimůnek, who took it on, managed everything and survived.

Rymice – Felling of the Rymice maypole

After the north of the country we headed to more distant corners of Moravia. On Friday Matouš Balík and Vlasta set off towards Holešov, where the traditional felling of the maypole was taking place in the picturesque village of Rymice. It came down just as they arrived, so the guys saw it hit the road in front of their car. The exhibition then took place by the stage at the local municipal office. The local crowd, young and old, enjoyed the event and cheered like crazy throughout our exhibition. We also battled the slippery surface of the outdoor dance floor in front of the stage, and there were some impressive performances over the final tape from both Matouš and Vlasta.

Zubří – Chocolate Slipper children's sports day

Our team was already in Zubří back in 2017, and the locals chose us again to celebrate the 10th anniversary of this local event. The beautiful athletics grounds of the local school were complemented by sunny, hot weather and a huge turnout of spectators, who even had a grandstand for more comfortable viewing of the rich programme prepared by the organisers. After almost 4 hours of driving, Lukáš Valný and Vlasta took care of the event, riding a 30-minute exhibition including competitions for kids and jumping over the tape. Thanks to everyone for your support, and congratulations to the young athletes on taking part and on their placings.

exhibicni-serie-na-zaver-prazdnin.titulek: An exhibition series to end the summer holidays
exhibicni-serie-na-zaver-prazdnin.perex: The second-to-last Saturday of the summer holidays brought us a small three-course series. We visited a fairly big corporate event in northern Bohemia with Martin Šimůnek, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and…
exhibicni-serie-na-zaver-prazdnin.obsah:
The second-to-last Saturday of the summer holidays brought us a small three-course series. We visited a fairly big corporate event in northern Bohemia with Martin Šimůnek, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Matouš Balík. Vlasta and Matouš then headed to a real village event in Mečeříž, where the local crowd was waiting for them at the 'Farewell to the Holidays' event. Martin Šimůnek continued on a solo ride in Králův Dvůr, where he let himself be egged on into jumping off a shipping container converted into toilets :)

In the morning it looked like a rainy day, but in the end the weather was 100% perfect – which can't be said of the following few days.

kdyz-sjezd-vyhraje-trialista.titulek: When a Trial rider wins the downhill
kdyz-sjezd-vyhraje-trialista.perex: Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček's report from the exhibition in Rakovník, where he, Lukáš Valný and Martin Šimůnek fell victim to a downhillers' conspiracy 🙂 "Rakovnické cyklování is one of the big cycling…
kdyz-sjezd-vyhraje-trialista.obsah:
Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček's report from the exhibition in Rakovník, where he, Lukáš Valný and Martin Šimůnek fell victim to a downhillers' conspiracy 🙂

"Rakovnické cyklování is one of the big cycling events, normally allowing riders to start in 7 disciplines – from XC to the Downtown urban downhill. Unfortunately the coronavirus affected events like this too, so the organiser had to keep participant numbers down. Anyway, the event went ahead, and a day full of action awaited me, Martin Šimůnek and Lukáš Valný. 

Originally we only went for 3 exhibition shows, and in the gap between the 2nd and 3rd we planned to test the local trails. It all ended differently – after we tried the footbridge over the local lake, where a crossing race was to take place the next day, the organisers of the downhill part offered us a ride in the exhibition downhill race instead of the trails. None of us had ever ridden downhill, and since the course was short and had no jumps, we said why not. The organisers even moved the start for us so we could make our last exhibition show.

Practice was great, and the tight corners probably gave us a bit of an advantage, because anyone who could get through on the front wheel gained a lot. It was practically a pure technique downhill. Based on practice I personally thought Lukáš Valný would be on the podium, but what do I know. Martin Šimůnek's 10-year-old Remedy is a bit worn out, and he was a bit out of place on 26”, but…. A race is a race and Martin has it in his blood. Without a front brake he still took 8th place out of 15 riders. Lukáš Valný was second after the first run but finished 4th in the end. At the awards ceremony we had long since changed and were practising back on our Trial bikes (it takes a moment to get used to them again), so we found it strange that they were calling us to the podium. The announcement of the downhill winner was a bit of a shock for everyone, including me. I was the only one who somehow got under 20 seconds, and with a relaxed ride I won. At first I thought they were joking (it would be just like the guys), but after checking the results I went up on the podium for the diploma. So among my dreams come true, besides Trial titles, I can now tick off a win in a DH race :D Here's to chance and Trial skills."

20-21-5-exhibice-prazske-sluzby-strupcic.titulek: 20–21/5 – Exhibitions for Pražské služby, Strupčice and ON Semiconductor
20-21-5-exhibice-prazske-sluzby-strupcic.perex: We spent the weekend of 20–21 May on the bike again, but this time in nice weather that accompanied us on our long journeys. On Saturday the traditional Pražské služby event took place in Malešice,…
20-21-5-exhibice-prazske-sluzby-strupcic.obsah:
We spent the weekend of 20–21 May on the bike again, but this time in nice weather that accompanied us on our long journeys. On Saturday the traditional Pražské služby event took place in Malešice, where Vlasta and Michal Budský rode together with parkour athletes and freestyle guys. The first show was by the ramp and the second right in front of the main stage. Besides the adrenaline on bikes, we got some traffic adrenaline as a bonus. Mini cars for teenage drivers were being tested at the event, driving near our obstacles, and while we were setting up, one of the cars crashed into the obstacles and pushed them together just as Vlasta was between them. Luckily the driver slammed on the brakes, so only the car's lights suffered and Vlasta went to change his underwear. 

After the event in Malešice, Vlasta shot off without Michal to Strupčice and its luxurious swimming pool complex. Who would have thought such a small village could have such a nice sports complex. The whole event, headed by Martin Šimůnek, was a bit more intimate than the others but superbly prepared. We stretched it out a bit with competitions for the spectators and rewarded young bikers with signed cards.

Sunday was all about a trip to Wallachia, where one of the world's largest chip manufacturers was celebrating. Unfortunately the professionally prepared event was disrupted at the end by an approaching storm. Luckily improvisation is our domain, and right after arriving Vlasta and Michal prepared a backup option under a tent instead of the outdoor show. It looked as if it would be unnecessary, but in the end it really did rain and we rode mainly under the tent. At the end there was some egging on, and a jump from the trailer over a new Škoda Enyaq was prepared. In the wet it was a bit close to the windscreen, but in the end even a double attempt worked out 🙂

During the week we rode a few individual training sessions and checked the route for the camps, so there was plenty of fun.

toyota-motors-tht-cz-a-zakupy-firemni-ak.titulek: TOYOTA Motors, THT.cz and Zákupy corporate events
toyota-motors-tht-cz-a-zakupy-firemni-ak.perex: September events – TOYOTA Motors, THT.cz and Zákupy corporate events September was crazy right from the start, and the weather did its thing with our calendar. But that's nothing compared to the…
toyota-motors-tht-cz-a-zakupy-firemni-ak.obsah:
September events – TOYOTA Motors, THT.cz and Zákupy corporate events

September was crazy right from the start, and the weather did its thing with our calendar. But that's nothing compared to the disaster that hit many people across the Czech Republic, and unfortunately the water didn't avoid us either (though only on a small scale). Events planned for the dates of the floods were of course all cancelled, and some others still being booked were cancelled too because of the clean-up.

At the start of the rains we practically only managed a corporate event for THT.cz, a manufacturer of fire and rescue vehicles. The event was indoors, so there was no problem, and we even managed to include a fire trailer, which they slightly modified for us. Vlasta's participation was in doubt because of a sprained ankle, but a bit of luck and his colleague Martin Šimůnek got him through the pain.

On this last weekend, when the worst has hopefully been averted / survived, we rode an exhibition for the guys from the Czech Olympic Committee and the partner of our Olympians – vehicle manufacturer TOYOTA in Kolín, right at their plant. Unfortunately the grassy area was still a bit waterlogged, so the exhibition had to be built so that the riders rode on the ground as little as possible. So we connected the stage to our obstacles and trailer. The ground was taken over by our Trial baby Marty Kabeláč, who showed adults and kids what a 7-year-old nipper can do. Martin Šimůnek and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček then went wild on the obstacles in two shows. In Martin's case you could say he was breaking chains – because that's exactly what he managed when jumping from obstacle to obstacle. Luckily nothing was broken, and by some miracle he managed to walk away and host the rest of the show. During the second show the area in front of the obstacles dried out a bit, so we could hold a tape-jump competition with the spectators. The Trial part was part of a mini Olympic village where competitions took place as part of a sports day. Thanks for the invitation.

Right after the second show at Toyota we set off for two more exhibitions in Zákupy, where there was also a corporate event for employees. A smaller event, where Martin's sparring partner Mirek Brunclík was already waiting for us with a workshop. Martin fixed his bike, but Márty Kabeláč crashed on the concrete; after treatment he sat by the obstacles with an ice cream and kept his fingers crossed for us. The two shows with a competition for volunteers ran a bit long, and we got egged on to a tape jump of around 125–130 cm. 

We're sorting out the photos, so for now just a few quick ones in the gallery.

radeni-na-it-konferenci.titulek: Going wild at an IT conference
radeni-na-it-konferenci.perex: Last week Vlasta and our young club gun Tobík Dolák rode an exhibition for Alternativo at the beautiful Valeč chateau, where they held a small IT conference focused on security. And since you ride…
radeni-na-it-konferenci.obsah:
Last week Vlasta and our young club gun Tobík Dolák rode an exhibition for Alternativo at the beautiful Valeč chateau, where they held a small IT conference focused on security. And since you ride safely on a bike too and the gentlemen from the management are athletes, they chose us. Low ceilings, a slippery floor, and Tobík forgot his helmet. Not exactly the ideal combo for an exhibition. The helmet wasn't a disaster, because one of the bosses is his dad – so as punishment he just had to tidy up.

We also roped in a young intern and a few conference visitors, so everyone was happy and we got a few photos too.

nas-obchod.perex: During February and March we will have our SHOP fully up and running for you.
nas-obchod.obsah:
During February and March we will have our SHOP fully up and running for you. Our partners supply us with only the best from their range. We test it during our training, races and exhibitions, and add to our range everything we would put our hand in the fire for.

POC / MALOJA / LEZYNE / BIKEWORX / SPANK / SUPACAZ and many other brands from the LEVELSPORTKONCEPT portfolio are, in our opinion, among the very best you can buy for your bike.

Special purchase discounts are available for participants of our courses and camps!

You can also treat your loved ones, friends or colleagues. Just give them a Bikeskills voucher, which lets them experience something unusual on a bike while improving their technique.

Of course, if you can't find something in our range, just let us know and we'll get the products for you.

We ship goods cash on delivery or with payment in advance.

AND WATCH OUT – we're preparing our own jerseys and accessories too :)

otevreni-cube-store-karlovy-vary.titulek: Opening of the CUBE STORE Karlovy Vary
otevreni-cube-store-karlovy-vary.perex: Our Trialshow.cz team, which includes a large number of the Bikeskills project instructors, is slowly starting to develop a partnership with CUBE, the largest bike manufacturer in Europe. The first…
otevreni-cube-store-karlovy-vary.obsah:
Our Trialshow.cz team, which includes a large number of the Bikeskills project instructors, is slowly starting to develop a partnership with CUBE, the largest bike manufacturer in Europe.

The first swallow of this partnership was Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček signing a contract to promote the brand, followed straight away by this year's first exhibition at the opening of the CUBE STORE Karlovy Vary, hosted by the exceptional Marek Eben.

A luxurious, stylish shop full of bikes is a rarity these days. Vlasta and Martin Šimůnek jumped over the ribbon meant to be cut (and almost cut it with a chain on one of the jumps), and did a short show on small obstacles.

Martin Šimůnek then saddled a small kids' bike and showed that it's no problem to ride on the back wheel or hop on the front wheel even on an 18" bike :)

detsky-den-na-ladronce-a-cykloden-brezno.titulek: Children's day at Ladronka and Cycling day in Březno
detsky-den-na-ladronce-a-cykloden-brezno.perex: Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Martin Šimůnek enjoyed two shows at Ladronka and one longer exhibition at the local Cycling Day in Březno on a beautiful, almost summery Sunday. At Ladronka the guys were…
detsky-den-na-ladronce-a-cykloden-brezno.obsah:
Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Martin Šimůnek enjoyed two shows at Ladronka and one longer exhibition at the local Cycling Day in Březno on a beautiful, almost summery Sunday. 

At Ladronka the guys were joined by a group of parkour athletes, and together they put on a decent show for a chanting crowd. 

The Cycling Day was at a more relaxed pace, with Vlasta's offspring getting involved and firing up the local kids, who tried out the smallest obstacles after the exhibition. In the end even the parents ended up on bikes :)

listopadova-sleva-bikeskills.perex: There's not much riding to be done now, so it's time to service and upgrade our machines. Hopefully our November sale will help you with that. If you're interested in more products, write to us and…
listopadova-sleva-bikeskills.obsah: There's not much riding to be done now, so it's time to service and upgrade our machines. Hopefully our November sale will help you with that. If you're interested in more products, write to us and we'll gladly recommend, advise and prepare a tailor-made offer.

exhibice-vodaren-transport.perex: Over the weekend Šimon and Čihi rode for Vodárek Transport in the picturesque town of Hulín. The guys' opening act was Zdeněk Izer. The weather was lucky in the truest sense of the word. A spur of a massive storm cloud ended exactly at Hulín, and if the guys had turned left instead of right at the junction, they would have driven straight into rain instead of a beautiful sunny day. We rode a slightly longer and more action-packed version of the exhibition, the spectators…
exhibice-vodaren-transport.obsah: Over the weekend Šimon and Čihi rode for Vodárek Transport in the picturesque town of Hulín. The guys' opening act was Zdeněk Izer. The weather was lucky in the truest sense of the word. A spur of a massive storm cloud ended exactly at Hulín, and if the guys had turned left instead of right at the junction, they would have driven straight into rain instead of a beautiful sunny day. We rode a slightly longer and more action-packed version of the exhibition, the spectators were great and we're glad for the praise from the organisers. Hopefully back in Hulín soon.

primestsky-camp-2.perex: The second day camp started with a rainy day and temperatures below 20°C. Surprisingly, that didn't put off many participants, and combined with the growing interest in our camps, 27 kids came along…
primestsky-camp-2.obsah:
The second day camp started with a rainy day and temperatures below 20°C. Surprisingly, that didn't put off many participants, and combined with the growing interest in our camps, 27 kids came along plus a few from our club. We originally didn't want to exceed the rider limit we'd set, but the kids were disciplined and loved the bikes, so our main carers and coaches could handle it. Unfortunately we had to turn away further substitutes – hopefully see you next year.

We covered everything from the pump track, berms and obstacles to jumps for the bravest. On Thursday there was also Trial training for everyone who owns a Trial bike. Those who don't still had the chance to try the basics during one of the sessions. The final pump track race was dramatic until the end and a nice full stop to the whole camp, where you could see improvement in most riders. Every day there were also rides around the area to build fitness (although that's not our priority, unlike technique).

holky-ladi-bikeskills-vol-2.titulek: Women Tune Up with BIKESKILLS vol. 2
holky-ladi-bikeskills-vol-2.perex: We have another one-day camp for women and girls behind us, created at the request of our clients and friends, and also thanks to interest from participants of the first camp. As interest in the…
holky-ladi-bikeskills-vol-2.obsah:
We have another one-day camp for women and girls behind us, created at the request of our clients and friends, and also thanks to interest from participants of the first camp.

As interest in the camp was a bit greater than last time, we called to arms not only Katarína, Mára and Vlasta, but also Lukáš Valný, who was missing last time, and special thanks for rescuing the tent and looking after our things go to Matouš Balík from our home club.

The morning programme was devoted to basic technique – in other words, we learn what we'll try to use off-road in the afternoon. At noon we rode at an easy pace to Hotel Legner Zvánovice, where all participants refuelled, and after a short break we practised off-road riding.

There was also a workshop by Mára Tryner focused on classic bike maintenance and dealing with emergency situations riders may encounter on the bike.

Thanks to all participants and instructors – hopefully we'll soon manage to put together next year's calendar with events for everyone.

exhibice-a-workshopy-bartosovice-vrbatky.titulek: Exhibitions and workshops in Bartošovice, Vrbátky and Malé Žernoseky
exhibice-a-workshopy-bartosovice-vrbatky.perex: Triple exhibitions are always more demanding, both in coordinating times and the team. If workshops are added, it's even more demanding. Martin Šimůnek, Michal…
exhibice-a-workshopy-bartosovice-vrbatky.obsah:
Triple exhibitions are always more demanding, both in coordinating times and the team. If workshops are added, it's even more demanding. Martin Šimůnek, Michal Budský and Mára Tryner set off on a longer route to Bartošovice and Vrbátky, where crowds of spectators and bike enthusiasts awaited them.


The guys showed what they could and at the same time taught those interested Trial and MTB in our workshops. Vlasta, Lukáš Valný and Tobík Dolák went the opposite way to Malé Žernoseky, where besides the exhibition their task was a mini workshop for visitors.


After swapping slots with the dog handlers (so the dogs could have some peace), we rode the show, tested the local concrete walls a bit and held a mini workshop. Thanks for the invitation and the great turnout.

vyukova-lekce-pro-klub.perex: The crisis has been here for a few weeks now and caught us in the middle of preparing our project. Being flexible, instead of sitting on our hands we decided to film a few coaching lessons for the…
vyukova-lekce-pro-klub.obsah:
The crisis has been here for a few weeks now and caught us in the middle of preparing our project. Being flexible, instead of sitting on our hands we decided to film a few coaching lessons for the boys and girls from our club MTB & TRIAL Mraveniště Říčany . The first piece is more of an attempt to produce something that makes sense without a camera, a microphone or any directing experience.

For now we're going for less information and more watching, so we'll see what feedback we get from our training group.

ricanske-slapacky-2021.perex: The date of the event was set last spring, but it was still unclear whether the event could be held this year at all. We knew we were going for a lean solution and adapted the programme accordingly.…
ricanske-slapacky-2021.obsah:
The date of the event was set last spring, but it was still unclear whether the event could be held this year at all. We knew we were going for a lean solution and adapted the programme accordingly. One of the big concessions was cancelling the riders from England, as it was impossible to predict how the pandemic and the limits on the number of starters would develop.
In the end we kept the event in the Tehov park again, thanks also to the support of the municipality and local people, and it turned out to be a good choice. The preparation itself was marked by rain and storms, which complicated mainly the pump track and in the end forced us to cancel the beam and log section for Trial, which we shed a few tears over given all the fine-tuning.


We won't beat around the bush. The weather turned out great, over 90 riders came, and thanks to TERRA (JCB), Autosalon BENO Říčany (ŠKODA), the Inplem farm, the Tehov volunteer fire brigade, instructor Klárka Hájková, the guys from Cage Warriors, perfect sound and hosting by Aleš Matoušek and many volunteers, an estimated 500–600 spectators came throughout the day. In the morning they cheered on the Trial riders and the motorbike exhibition by Dalibor Šulc and Tomáš Hůla. Some combined it with a trip from the children's day in Říčany, so the chance to operate a digger, pet the cows or play with the firefighters' equipment was certainly an interesting bonus for all the kids (and, let's be honest, for us parents and riders too).
This year Trial was divided into several parts. Unfortunately holidays and injuries weakened our club line-up a bit, and some took on organisational duties rather than the handlebars, but even so the kids' categories filled up beyond expectations. After the kids, the Elite riders took to the course. As it was an exhibition race, everyone rode in one category, so the guys could compare themselves with each other as in the final of a big race. The courses were rideable and set with the weather in mind, but there were a few sharper passages too. Lukáš Valný deserves huge respect – despite being heavily involved in the organisation, he finished third. Matouš Balík's performance was a surprise: although he's a junior by age, thanks to consistent riding he scored just 6 penalty points. The club kids were curious about Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček's performance, and probably even he didn't know what to expect after 2 years without racing, with 40 on his neck and after his 6th knee operation. A new bike and a relaxed race resulted in 0 penalty points, so there was no contest.


The break between the kids' and adults' practice was filled with a small jumping contest, won once again with an exhibition performance by Vlasta, with 120 cm over the tape and a 225 cm jump off a height, ahead of Lukáš Valný, Tomáš Kočička and Matouš Balík.


In the afternoon the main roles were played by the boys and girls on the pump track, battling against the clock at a very sharp pace. Lots of kids came to see how much they could get out of themselves. The highlight of the day was the full-suspension race, dominated by the local duo of Lukáš's. Lukáš Turek took first place and also fifth in Experts (hardtails). After the Trial and especially the whole week of preparations, Lukáš Valný had to wake up a bit, but made up for it with 2nd place, becoming the only rider to stand on the podium in all disciplines.


The junior category was taken by talented rider Tobík Dolák, who after a very decent Trial performance jumped on a hardtail and won ahead of the winner of one of the kids' Trial categories, Jonáš Vavřinec, and Tommi Neuwirth.
The highlight of the event was the Expert category race, with a number of top riders including MTB legend Michal Maroši. Michal suffered a bit after his vaccination, but switched into race mode, grabbed the prize money with first place, including the best jump award, ahead of Alex Sidor and Hugo Novák. Unfortunately there was no shortage of crashes either. The Best Crash award went to Martin Králíček, who luckily only came away with a decent supply of scrapes. Worse was the result of an innocent misstep by Martin Vavřinec, who chose the pump track race over Trial and unfortunately tore his cruciate ligament. We wish him a speedy recovery. The best-placed woman, despite a dislocating shoulder and three kids to look after, was another instructor from the club – Katarína Tóthová.


Many thanks to everyone for taking part, helping and supporting. We are donating part of the entry fees to support people affected by the tornado. Unfortunately this also affected several riders who were supposed to come, so hopefully it will help a little. We also thank the municipality of Tehov for supporting the event and lending us the park, and of course the town of Říčany.


A video from the event will follow – hopefully see you at the next edition. You can also watch a short report on ČT Déčko (we'll announce the date).


The team of the MTB & TRIAL Mraveniště Říčany club and the organisers of Říčanské Šlapačky

bikeskills-campy-no-1.perex: We held the first two classic camps of our Bikeskills project, once again split into female bikers (Saturday) and male bikers (Sunday). Surprisingly, once again more women came, and thanks to the…
bikeskills-campy-no-1.obsah: We held the first two classic camps of our Bikeskills project, once again split into female bikers (Saturday) and male bikers (Sunday). Surprisingly, once again more women came, and thanks to the weather too it turned into a relaxed day on the bike, where the women made progress on everything we came across, including steps, benches and things they probably wouldn't ride on their own. There were fewer men, and all the more exhausted they were. Fewer riders, more riding :) All under the guidance of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Katarína Tóthová. We hope the riders found a new perspective on riding and perhaps goals for the future.

festival-rekordu-pelhrimov-a-firemni-akc.titulek: Pelhřimov Festival of Records and a corporate event
festival-rekordu-pelhrimov-a-firemni-akc.perex: Today we broke our record for the number of riders deployed (not counting side programmes at trade fairs). Vlasta, Martin Šimůnek, kids from the club and Tobík Dolák went on bikes to the Festival of…
festival-rekordu-pelhrimov-a-firemni-akc.obsah:
Today we broke our record for the number of riders deployed (not counting side programmes at trade fairs). Vlasta, Martin Šimůnek, kids from the club and Tobík Dolák went on bikes to the Festival of Records in Pelhřimov, which was celebrating its founding anniversary. On a motorbike there was Dalibor Šulc, plus parkour athletes Ondra and Honza from Flow Vision. Lukáš Valný and Michal Budský were busy at a corporate event in Žatec.

The festival itself nailed the weather, and in almost 28 degrees records were broken all day, concerts took place and you could try out lots of attractions. Our team was placed right next to the main stage, and our task in 3 main 40-minute  shows was both to perform and to set new Czech records. We left the first show without records but made it longer. In the second show Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Honza Daleký set a record in the standing long jump – Honza with feet together and Vlasta from back wheel to back wheel between two obstacles. Together that gave the guys 5.6 metres in the final attempts. Honza also set a standing jump record for parkour. Vlasta didn't beat his existing Czech record.
The last, shortest show at the end of the event was dedicated to Dalibor Šulc's record attempt: he set a Czech record for spins on the back wheel – 6 spins on the spot on the back wheel in 36 seconds.
We gave the shows our all and unfortunately not without injuries. First, parkour athlete Ondra broke a metatarsal bone in his foot, but neither the spectators nor the rest of us noticed anything until he started complaining about pain in his foot. Our youngest rider, Márty Kabeláč, fooled around on the back wheel for so long that he hit his nose and left an indelible pool of blood on Pelhřimov square. But by the last show he was back on the bike. Among other things, there was also a workshop for visitors.

martin-simunek-v-milovicich-a-struharove.titulek: Martin Šimůnek in Milovice and Struhařov
martin-simunek-v-milovicich-a-struharove.perex: When everyone on the team is on holiday, Martin keeps riding. An indestructible rider who, even on the threshold of 50, manages several exhibitions a week plus rides in the bike park or on the…
martin-simunek-v-milovicich-a-struharove.obsah:
When everyone on the team is on holiday, Martin keeps riding. An indestructible rider who, even on the threshold of 50, manages several exhibitions a week plus rides in the bike park or on the trails around Česká Lípa – and on top of that he's a multiple national and world champion. This time Martin stood in for the guys, who were on a well-deserved holiday, at the local children's day in Milovice and in Struhařov – close to traditional Trial and MTB spots.

A few photos from Struhařov have just arrived, so take a look at how Martin still jumps.

ricansky-busking-food-festival.perex: Unfortunately we don't often get the chance to ride exhibitions in the home town of our club, MTB & Trial Mraveniště Říčany.
ricansky-busking-food-festival.obsah:
Unfortunately we don't often get the chance to ride exhibitions in the home town of our club, MTB & Trial Mraveniště Říčany. So we were all the more eager to accept the invitation from the organisers of the Busking and Food Festival on Říčany square, and at the same time the offer to promote the Bikefestival in Tehov, which we are organising on 25/26 June. As it's a festival of street art and food, we also tested our portable sound system with a microphone, which extends our team's ability to perform even without sound provided by the organiser.

The exhibition was ridden by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Matouš Balík, who showed the people of Říčany a slightly higher level of Trial. There was some extra egging on over volunteers and riding on the traditional steps by the church after the exhibition. Thanks to all the locals for your support :)

prvni-bikeskills-campy-hlasi-splneno.titulek: The first Bikeskills camps – mission accomplished
prvni-bikeskills-campy-hlasi-splneno.perex: For the first time in the history of our project we tried starting the camp season in April. We cancelled the first date because of snow and debated whether to keep the 28–29 April date too. We can…
prvni-bikeskills-campy-hlasi-splneno.obsah:
For the first time in the history of our project we tried starting the camp season in April. We cancelled the first date because of snow and debated whether to keep the 28–29 April date too. We can only thank our participants for their flexibility – after looking at the Sunday forecast, they agreed to move to the Saturday date.

Our coaches were able to cover both the men's and the women's group and make full use of the beautiful Sunday weather. The men threw themselves into the terrain and natural features in the beautiful Struhařov forests, while the ladies focused on technique in the Tehov park before moving to the nearby trails.

Thanks to everyone for taking part and for your willingness. Hopefully you'll notice the improvement on every ride this year.

exhibice-na-mega-akcich-17-18-6.obsah:
17/6 Jablonné – UEC European Marathon Championships

The slightly tabloid headline of this report literally reflects the type of events our team took part in.

First up were the European Marathon Championships, with Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Martin Šimůnek, who besides the main exhibition at the opening ceremony also rode at the local school for almost 300 pupils, including a small workshop. On the square there was a slight delay to the ceremony itself, but the spectators cheered all the more even in the rising heat.

18/6 Ralsko – Forestry Days 2022

Forestry Days is a traditional event where over 15,000 people head to the middle of the forest to admire forestry machinery, hunters' trophies and everything connected with the forest and its care. Martin Šimůnek, Dominik Budský and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček could already feel the approaching heat right behind their ears, but they still rode a relatively brisk exhibition on the STIHL Timbersports stage, including jumping over champion lumberjacks. Pack up and head for the furnace of Česká Lípa …

Česká Lípa – Town festival

During the day the centre of Česká Lípa welcomed literally thousands of people, who enjoyed both the nearby fair and attractions and the main stage, where a number of well-known bands performed. Scorching heat of over 32 degrees and an asphalt surface aren't exactly ideal for drawing people in, but our team still managed to fill the square. Martin Šimůnek, Vlasta, Dominik Budský (unicyclist) and Matouš Balík were joined by local Trial legend and Martin's first student Majkl Matys, who got his Trial bike out after many years and showed that some things you never forget. Thanks partly to his help the heat was bearable, and together with Vlasta they pulled off big ones over the tape along with the competitors. Four generations of Trial riders effectively had a chance to meet at the exhibition.

Liberec – international Megamini handball tournament

Without Michal and Dominik, our team headed to Liberec for an event for a few hundred enthusiastic handball players. Luckily the exhibition was aimed at the after-party, held outdoors and in the shade. The heat had caused one of the ramps onto the obstacles to crack at the previous exhibitions, and the riders were showing a certain amount of fatigue too. But the crowd of enthusiastic athletes gave us energy, and with help from the club's little ones Marty and Nikolka Kabeláč, a 30-minute show got going that entertained kids and adults alike. Matouš Balík seemed the freshest of all – he even won the mini contest in the tape jump. We got home well after 10, but full of experiences.

tour-de-zelenak.perex: A traditional event for Martin Šimůnek and something new for Vlasta as a guest rider. The big North Bohemian cycling race impressed with the quality of its organisation, its side programme and above…
tour-de-zelenak.obsah:
A traditional event for Martin Šimůnek and something new for Vlasta as a guest rider. The big North Bohemian cycling race impressed with the quality of its organisation, its side programme and above all more than 900 registered riders. The pleasant surroundings of the Rumburk centre also attracted countless spectators, who together with the riders created a nice backdrop for our exhibition. 

We coped with the smaller space and stretched the exhibition out a bit. We also invited a young gun from the crowd, who had ridden the race as a Junior but caught the Trial bug at the workshop and managed a few basic moves. Thanks for the invitation to this 39th edition – and here's to the 40th.

holky-ladi-bikeskills-semberske-stezky.titulek: Women Tune Up with Bikeskills – Šembera trails
holky-ladi-bikeskills-semberske-stezky.perex: This weekend, and Friday too, was a bit more demanding. Getting used to the coaching pace and organising events after Covid is tough, but the results are worth it. On Friday and Saturday Vlasta had…
holky-ladi-bikeskills-semberske-stezky.obsah:
This weekend, and Friday too, was a bit more demanding. Getting used to the coaching pace and organising events after Covid is tough, but the results are worth it. On Friday and Saturday Vlasta had individual coaching in Tehov, while Mára, Lukáš and Katarína with Matouš taught skill-hungry women and girls on the Šembera trails. In the individual courses the main goal was learning to jump benches. Surprisingly, everyone who came – even though it didn't look like it at first – fought hard and sent the benches at full commitment.  

So far we've also collected positive reactions about the camp. The Šembera trails are aimed more at families and kids, but you can still find a few things there where a rider can learn something and fine-tune their style. Some riders found the trail profile just right for them, while others would deserve harder, more demanding sections.

You keep bombarding us with interest in a camp during or after the summer holidays. We'll try to prepare a few dates, but given our Trial exhibitions it will take some time. It should be clear in the first week of July :)

Next weekend, "btw", you can see us at www.vsenakolech.cz in Kostelec or in Prostřední Bečva in Moravia.

festival-houpacka-dobrocinna-exhibice-ve.titulek: Houpačka Festival – charity exhibition in Velešín
festival-houpacka-dobrocinna-exhibice-ve.perex: Another interesting festival took place in Velešín. Unfortunately, because of traffic Vlasta and Lukáš arrived late and had to battle against time to get everything done. We opened the whole event…
festival-houpacka-dobrocinna-exhibice-ve.obsah: Another interesting festival took place in Velešín. Unfortunately, because of traffic Vlasta and Lukáš arrived late and had to battle against time to get everything done. We opened the whole event and were the opening act for the invited bands. Lots of attractions and music performances attracted a relatively large number of spectators even at the start, who came to watch our exhibition too, which we squeezed into about 25 minutes including a competition for volunteers. Thanks for the invitation – next time we'll try to arrive earlier :)

testovani-bikeparku-a-mensi-vikendove-ex.titulek: Bike park testing and smaller weekend exhibitions
testovani-bikeparku-a-mensi-vikendove-ex.perex: 22/7 – Day camp exhibition – Petrohrad The Friday farewell for kids at the camps in Petrohrad is ridden every year by Martin Šimůnek, but he was called away by family commitments and it was up to…
testovani-bikeparku-a-mensi-vikendove-ex.obsah:
22/7 – Day camp exhibition – Petrohrad

The Friday farewell for kids at the camps in Petrohrad is ridden every year by Martin Šimůnek, but he was called away by family commitments and it was up to Vlasta to stand in for him. What could be better than taking along the smallest rider from the club, Marty, to ride a show with his dad for participants of the same age or older? 

The sun was scorching a bit, but after the exhibition we still held a small workshop for those interested, lending bikes to an estimated 40–50 kids, including competitions. 

23/7 – Test camp and exhibition at Polevsko bike park – Polevsko near Česká Lípa

We needed to thoroughly test the Polevsko bike park for possible camps in 2023, and the Saturday coaching event with a Trial exhibition, to which Martin and Vlasta were invited, was the ideal chance to ride the whole park to the full. Club rider Petr Jeřicha used the spare seat in the car to train for the Enduro Series, and despite the bad forecast set off with Vlasta to meet Martin and host Michal Matys. 

Apart from a few morning drops, luckily it didn't rain until 3 pm, so we managed to coach a small group of bikers, ride 2 short exhibitions and do some photography. We went through the tricky parts of the local trails and the bike park's options and rode the local chairlift. For us, Polevsko is a nice family bike park with technique, jumps and a few small drops. Its 4 trails will soon be extended by an almost 8 km trail, but even in their current state, with multiple lines and hidden jumps, they'll keep every biker entertained.

We look forward to next year and a possible Bikeskills camp or coaching.

slavnosti-vysni-lhota.perex: One of this year's longest trips to an exhibition, to Vyšní Lhota, was made by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Tobík Dolák and Marty Kabeláč. The interesting setting attracted a few hundred spectators, who…
slavnosti-vysni-lhota.obsah:
One of this year's longest trips to an exhibition, to Vyšní Lhota, was made by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Tobík Dolák and Marty Kabeláč. The interesting setting attracted a few hundred spectators, who partied at the concerts despite the sweltering heat, and our exhibition was really an adrenaline addition to a rock afternoon and evening.

In two shows they rode both a classic exhibition and a show with egging on for bigger jumps and competitions for spectators. The local hospitality is definitely worth a mention too – we hadn't been so stuffed between exhibitions for a long time.

Thanks for the invitation

kulovy-blesk-1-pradedeckuv-traktor-a-pis.titulek: Ball Lightning 1 – Great-Grandpa's Tractor and Písek near Jablunkov
kulovy-blesk-1-pradedeckuv-traktor-a-pis.perex: Michal Budský and Mára Tryner made a proper Moravian trip, going from north to south. The first stop was a children's day in Písek near Jablunkov, where they started their exhibition on the team's…
kulovy-blesk-1-pradedeckuv-traktor-a-pis.obsah:
Michal Budský and Mára Tryner made a proper Moravian trip, going from north to south. The first stop was a children's day in Písek near Jablunkov, where they started their exhibition on the team's folding obstacles. 

Meanwhile Martin Šimůnek was running a workshop at a children's day in Hradec Králové, and Vlasta and Matouš set off for the traditional Great-Grandpa's Tractor event in Čáslav. Every year you can see loads of historic machinery, a programme for kids and adults, and occasionally more extreme things like our show. The guys rode two shows – the first to warm up and the second at full throttle for a decent number of spectators, who weren't put off even by the heat radiating from the melting asphalt.

melnicky-festival-dny-lesu-v-ralsku-a-ja.titulek: Mělník festival, forest days in Ralsko and Javornice day
melnicky-festival-dny-lesu-v-ralsku-a-ja.perex: Another weekend in full swing. On Friday we were busy at the Mělník festival in Podolí park, which moved from the Mělník riverside. Two shows with 5 riders in a pleasant park setting were great. We…
melnicky-festival-dny-lesu-v-ralsku-a-ja.obsah:
Another weekend in full swing. On Friday we were busy at the Mělník festival in Podolí park, which moved from the Mělník riverside. Two shows with 5 riders in a pleasant park setting were great. We also tested our new obstacle setup a bit more and new dual headset microphones for bigger events where we need two hosts. The spectators came to enjoy the event, so we could stretch out every show. Our obstacles were then used by the parkour athletes too. Martin Šimůnek once again proved that choosing volunteers is his weak point, when for the sideways jump he picked a local athlete who drew with Vlasta in the first show and blew him out like a candle in the athlete-vs-bike duel in the second.

On Saturday we went to the Military Forests Days in Ralsko, which was a trial by fire … or rather by water, for Vlasta, Michal Budský and Nikol Kabeláčová. Rain, a flat tyre on the trailer, more rain and luckily a roughly 20-minute window for the exhibition right at the end of the event. The guys at the Javornice festival had a longer drive, but Lukáš Valný, Ondra Nenadál and Tobík Dolák enjoyed the beautiful weather and the event and showed the locals how to jump over obstacles. Martin Šimůnek also spent his Saturday elsewhere near Ústí, going wild at a corporate event.

Photos for now are whatever we had, and hopefully something will arrive from the organisers, whom we thank for the invitation.

Photos by Šárka Zikmundová:

oteviracky-exhibice-a-workshopy-visky-u-.titulek: Season openers, exhibitions and workshops in Vísky u Letovic, Ostrava, Strážnice and Klánovice
oteviracky-exhibice-a-workshopy-visky-u-.perex: September was all about pump track openings, racing and big exhibitions across the country. Martin Šimůnek and Michal Budský headed to a big Moravian-Silesian Region event at Trojhalí in…
oteviracky-exhibice-a-workshopy-visky-u-.obsah:
September was all about pump track openings, racing and big exhibitions across the country. Martin Šimůnek and Michal Budský headed to a big Moravian-Silesian Region event at Trojhalí in Ostrava, where lots of concerts, workshops and performances took place in a beautiful setting.


The guys moved smoothly on to Strážnice, where the end of the cycling season was being celebrated, and again provided the local programme with two exhibition shows and a workshop, including hosting and the sound system.


Meanwhile Vlasta and Dalibor Šulc loaded the bikes and motorbikes and headed for Vísky u Letovic for the local village festival, where they put on exhibitions for a large audience from far and wide. They also battled the gravel, which complicated our show a little. Vlasta then went with the club kids to races in Thalheim, Germany, and the week before he did a marathon of coaching and more races in Slovakia.


At the beginning of October there was a big pump track opening in Prague-Klánovice. For Katarína Tóthová it was already one of several in a row, but this time, together with Vlasta and Marty, their task was to provide a complete 2-hour programme of exhibition, workshop and coaching – and they even threw in a mini race for the kids who came.


In October we also have the completion of the Říčany trail repairs, probably another Prague pump track opening and a club race in Tehov.

exhibice-a-workshopy-rasochy-mesice-a-lu.obsah:
At the end of the summer holidays and the start of the school year, besides coaching and training we also managed exhibitions. The first was at a cycling race in Rasochy, where a group of local bikers gathered for a traditional race around the area. Vlasta and Lukáš Valný coped with the uneven terrain and made full use of the space provided, to the organisers' satisfaction.


On the first Saturday of September Vlasta and Mára Tryner headed to nearby Měšice for the local festival, where we were the opening act for Kapitán DEMO and a few other bands and effectively closed an afternoon full of exhibitions and performances.


At the same time Martin Šimůnek and Matouš Balík went wild in Lubné near Polička, despite a small complication – they couldn't use their exhibition trailer. Luckily the obstacles are portable, so everything was sorted to the organiser's satisfaction. Both teams also had a bit of luck, because the weather wasn't ideal that day, but everything dried out nicely for the exhibitions. In the meantime Martin Šimůnek also managed several exhibitions and workshops 'around the house', as they say.


In the coming weeks we're in for a bit of a grind and some more big events. On top of that comes the repair of the trail we helped build in Říčany.

The scorching heat didn't stop us, and after the Pin-up girls were announced there was time to walk around the whole grounds. Thanks for the invitation.

prvni-venkovni-exhibice-a-trial-kurz.titulek: First outdoor exhibition and a Trial course
prvni-venkovni-exhibice-a-trial-kurz.perex: An outdoor exhibition in February? This year we kicked off the outdoor exhibition season really early, because a pig feast without bikes just isn't possible. Vlasta, Lukáš Valný and Matouš Balík…
prvni-venkovni-exhibice-a-trial-kurz.obsah:
An outdoor exhibition in February? This year we kicked off the outdoor exhibition season really early, because a pig feast without bikes just isn't possible. Vlasta, Lukáš Valný and Matouš Balík headed for the beautiful little town of Janovice nad Úhlavou.

The weather was literally a lottery. Rain and freezing temperatures a few days before an exhibition make every Trial rider a bit nervous. Anyway, 12 degrees and partly cloudy in February with a great audience was our reward. A bit of wind was no problem and we rode a solid 30-minute show in front of an amazing crowd. As a reward there was a bit of the pig feast. Thanks for the invitation.

---

In 2023 too we put together a group of enthusiasts who wanted to try Trial and gain some experience for the coming season. January was marked by illness and other work, so we only started in February. What was special about the course this time wasn't so much the skill of the participants – who battled with their habits and the Trial bike like their lives depended on it – but the make-up of the riders. Friday was made up purely of men and Saturday, by contrast, purely of women and girls. Hopefully everyone gained something from it and lost nothing.

den-mestske-policie-most.perex: Martin Šimůnek is as busy as at the start of his career, so once again Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček was called up; he took Matouš Balík and his three offspring and set off for the children's day organised…
den-mestske-policie-most.obsah:
Martin Šimůnek is as busy as at the start of his career, so once again Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček was called up; he took Matouš Balík and his three offspring and set off for the children's day organised by the Municipal Police in Most. Lots of attractions and the pleasant setting of the children's traffic playground attracted relatively many visitors.

The boys and girls came on at the very end of the event. First they jumped for the local TV, then they started the exhibition, which included crashes and a bit of blood. Simply an adrenaline show. Fortunately it was only a scraped knee and some scratches on the shins. Thanks to Martin and the Municipal Police for the invitation.

exhibicni-den-kunratice-skvorec-a-jablon.titulek: Exhibition day in Kunratice, Škvorec and Jablonec nad Nisou
exhibicni-den-kunratice-skvorec-a-jablon.perex: The weekend was 50/50 on whether weather apps work. Luckily they don't, so instead of the promised rain we rode all the booked events in two teams. Vlasta, Michal Budský, Ondřej Nenadál and later…
exhibicni-den-kunratice-skvorec-a-jablon.obsah:
The weekend was 50/50 on whether weather apps work. Luckily they don't, so instead of the promised rain we rode all the booked events in two teams. Vlasta, Michal Budský, Ondřej Nenadál and later Lukáš Valný had the Kunratice Indian Summer and the Škvorec fair on their plate. Martin Šimůnek took Jablonec nad Nisou. 

The Kunratice Indian Summer is a really successful mini-festival for kids and adults with concerts and loads of activities. The beautiful chateau park offered visitors just about everything you could think of at an event like this. In one longer show Vlasta, Michal and Ondra delivered a solid piece of action that entertained everyone present, including the organisers :). Vlasta tested a few setup changes on his new 26” trial bike. Michal Budský has ridden a street bike in recent years and Ondra represented the 20” trial bikes. So basically everything the Trial sport has to offer. 

After the exhibition we moved quickly to Škvorec, where we were invited for the second time to the local festival called the Škvorec fair. Lukáš Valný joined us there and we took up a tactical spot in the middle of the grounds. The local green and park were packed and concerts were under way. Our job was to ride 2 shows. Space was a bit tight, but that wasn't a problem for us. In the second show there was even an interesting tug of war among the local women and girls over who would become the volunteer living obstacle. Honestly, that's probably never happened to us before :)

Martin sent a few photos from the event he rode in Jablonec nad Nisou, and evidently he had a decent crowd at this little corporate event too, as is usual for him.
