vlasta-vyskakal-199-schodu-na-rozhlednu.titulek: Vlasta hopped up 199 steps of a lookout tower
vlasta-vyskakal-199-schodu-na-rozhlednu.perex: A lookout tower record and two team exhibitions – Miskovice and Hořepník. Sometimes ideas come up that turn out to be very much on the edge.
vlasta-vyskakal-199-schodu-na-rozhlednu.obsah:
A lookout tower record and two team exhibitions – Miskovice and Hořepník

Sometimes ideas come up that turn out to be very much on the edge. One of them was the idea from Miskovice and Aleš Matoušek to try riding up the local 199-step lookout tower on a bike. The choice fell on Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, holder of the record for riding up and down the Petřín lookout tower. 

As it was an exhibition show, there was first a roughly 30-minute demonstration with egging on from Lukáš Valný and Tobík Dolák. Vlasta then took a few minutes' rest and set off to conquer the tower. Without any practice. The crisis came right after the first floor and only deepened. The steps were small for the larger diameter of mountain bike wheels, and the metal itself didn't help with grip either. In the end it took a third more hops than there were steps. From the second floor on: cramps and braking with two fingers. But the goal wasn't just to get to the top – which he did in 4:05 min – but also to get back down, and that's where the biggest problem arose. The Cube e-bike available was great, but the steps were small and had no barriers at the railings to prevent falls. Twice it already looked like a trip over the handlebars, arrow pointing down, because of the cramps in his hands, but luckily after two dabs Vlasta found his rhythm and rode down the floors partly on the front wheel, so he fitted safely. Down in 2:51 min, and an overall time of 6:56.74 min is beyond expectations given the preparation and conditions. “After this I needed the whole day to pull myself together. I don't think I've ever been in worse physical shape after any sporting performance in my career, and physically it can't be compared with classic Trial. There, luckily, I do everything within 2 minutes and that's it. Thanks to the guys from the team, Aleš and my family for their help and support.” said Vlasta, commenting on setting the record

On the same day Martin Šimůnek and Michal Budský rode an exhibition at a witch-burning night, making a pleasant trip to Hořepník. The weather was kind to them and the turnout was good, so thanks for the invitation and hopefully again next year.

chlapi-ladi-bikeskills-no-2.titulek: Men Tune Up with Bikeskills no. 2
chlapi-ladi-bikeskills-no-2.perex: This year's last men's camp is behind us. Autumn is slowly taking its toll on attendance, and of course these dates aren't as popular. Moreover, we aimed this camp at more experienced riders. Besides…
chlapi-ladi-bikeskills-no-2.obsah:
This year's last men's camp is behind us. Autumn is slowly taking its toll on attendance, and of course these dates aren't as popular. Moreover, we aimed this camp at more experienced riders. Besides the traditional morning in the park on the jumps, pump track and skills centre, we included a slightly sharper part on natural obstacles and trails.

The transfer was combined with a restaurant visit, and after a bit of a rest we set off for some proper rocks. The guys dropped like their lives depended on it (sometimes literally), but you could see progress towards more confidence. Hopefully everyone moved forward, gained more confidence and, we hope, motivation for the heap of things still to learn. For us the main thing in autumn was the experience and a bit of practice in patching tyres and cursing the sealant :)

exhibice-video-treninky-report-21-22-8.perex: Vlasta reports from the weekend marathon of events: I haven't had legs this sore after any weekend this year. On Saturday we were invited to the Around the Republic marathon race in Žacléř, where a…
exhibice-video-treninky-report-21-22-8.obsah:
Vlasta reports from the weekend marathon of events:

I haven't had legs this sore after any weekend this year. On Saturday we were invited to the Around the Republic marathon race in Žacléř, where a group of cyclists set off on a course up to 1,500 km long (crazy people). After the start of the main category we jumped on the newly renovated square, including the new fountain (with permission from the mayor and the race director, of course).

The next exhibition was about 2 hours' drive away, but we said why not train in such beautiful sunny weather, which we haven't had much of this year. Our target was the nearest and relatively little-known Trial park of the Trutnov club, located at the Trutnov motocross club grounds. In the end we spent almost 2 hours there, including filming the most interesting little jumps.
https://www.instagram.com/tv/CS6gsLrlw9-/?utm_medium=copy_link
https://youtu.be/caAp7WWyPxs

Next we moved on to Rasochy, where about 125 bikers battled for trophies in XC races, including retro categories. The clods of turf in the meadow weren't a problem and the spectators created a great atmosphere, so we pulled out a few sharper tricks, like sitting on the handlebars, performed by Marek Tryner and Matouš Balík.

And on Sunday I had a lesson with a group of bikers that had already been rescheduled about 3 times, and which stretched from the original 4 hours to almost 8 hours including lunch. The guys went through the absolute basics, and we also threw ourselves at the pump track, forest obstacles and a few attempts on the jumps. To be continued next weekend.

letape-vitani-leta-lesnicky-den-a-detsky.titulek: L'Etape, welcoming summer, Forestry Day and a children's day
letape-vitani-leta-lesnicky-den-a-detsky.perex: We were riding on several fronts practically all weekend. On Saturday Martin Šimůnek and Míra Brunclík did the traditional Forestry Day near Česká Lípa. Michal Budský and Tobík Dolák, meanwhile,…
letape-vitani-leta-lesnicky-den-a-detsky.obsah:
We were riding on several fronts practically all weekend. On Saturday Martin Šimůnek and Míra Brunclík did the traditional Forestry Day near Česká Lípa. Michal Budský and Tobík Dolák, meanwhile, went wild on the folding obstacle set at a children's day in Český Jiřetín. And the biggest workload fell to Vlasta, Lukáš Valný and Nikolka Kabeláčová at one stop of the L'Etape amateur road races, followed by a transfer to the summer welcome in Doudleby nad Orlicí.

At first L'Etape was an intimate event, and our job was to entertain the spectators until the main part of the programme and the riders arrived. Of course we also entertained the organising team, whom we thank for the cooperation and hospitality. We had limited time, and after the exhibition only a few minutes to clear the area and flee ahead of the main peloton. Doudleby, by contrast, was a bigger event with a few hundred spectators, where we had a space next to the main stage and ran both an exhibition with volunteers – where the main star was the local history teacher – and a tape-jump contest, which ended in a draw between a local football star and Vlasta in a great atmosphere.

den-prazskych-sluzeb-a-cykloden.titulek: Pražské služby Day and a cycling day
den-prazskych-sluzeb-a-cykloden.perex: This time we rode as two teams. Michal Budský and the youngest, Tobík Dolák, headed near Sokolov for a local cycling day that was unfortunately rained out. The guys battled the weather, but of course…
den-prazskych-sluzeb-a-cykloden.obsah: This time we rode as two teams. Michal Budský and the youngest, Tobík Dolák, headed near Sokolov for a local cycling day that was unfortunately rained out. The guys battled the weather, but of course the weather affects everything. Vlasta, Martin Šimůnek and 3 little ones from the Kabeláč clan set off for the Pražské služby exhibition, where in two shows by the main stage they showed what can and can't be done on bikes. The second show was extended with an exhibition by the parkour guys and a Vlasta vs parkour battle (the result is secret :))

super-fast-camp.perex: We held a slightly different camp – or rather a Wednesday afternoon course – for enthusiasts who want to improve their bike technique. A few enduro riders and one action-loving female biker came…
super-fast-camp.obsah: We held a slightly different camp – or rather a Wednesday afternoon course – for enthusiasts who want to improve their bike technique. A few enduro riders and one action-loving female biker came along; with Katarína Tóthová they went through the basics and also threw themselves into fine-tuning berms and the other delights you meet on and off the trail.

exhibice-a-workshopy-cernovice-ricky-kvi.titulek: Exhibitions and workshops in Černovice, Říčky, Kvítkov and Nový Oldřichov
exhibice-a-workshopy-cernovice-ricky-kvi.perex: Half of August is gone and our team hasn't stopped. We started in Žimutice at a small village harvest festival, where Čihi and Lukáš Valný rode. A few individual MTB and Trial courses…
exhibice-a-workshopy-cernovice-ricky-kvi.obsah:
Half of August is gone and our team hasn't stopped. We started in Žimutice at a small village harvest festival, where Čihi and Lukáš Valný rode.


A few individual MTB and Trial courses followed. On 8/8 we were supposed to have a double exhibition, but unfortunately one was cancelled because of the death of the organiser, a long-time client of ours. So we headed to Černovice, where the 20th edition of 'Černovicko se baví' took place. An hour-long workshop followed by an exhibition on the main stage, and a reunion after many years between Martin Šimůnek and the host and sound engineer.


And this weekend, on 15/8, we did 3 exhibitions: Lukáš Valný and Marek Tryner did an intimate event in Říčky near the local bike park, while Šimon, Čihi and the little ones went to an event in Kvítkov near Česká Lípa and then opened for the band NoName in Mistrovice. So we alternated between audiences of a few dozen visitors and an event for a few thousand people. To be honest, all the events were accompanied by exhausting heat, which has hopefully eased for a week now, but we're grateful for the invitations and the chance to present our sport.

bikeskills-camp-mix.perex: For everyone who's bored over the summer holidays, as well as enthusiasts who want to perfect their technique, we prepared a small camp in the middle of the holidays. Katarína Tóthová took charge of…
bikeskills-camp-mix.obsah: For everyone who's bored over the summer holidays, as well as enthusiasts who want to perfect their technique, we prepared a small camp in the middle of the holidays. Katarína Tóthová took charge of the group of women and girls, and Vlasta looked after a group of bike-hungry guys. The weather was a bit disappointing, with beautiful sunshine alternating with local showers. Luckily it didn't affect morale, so the rainy breaks were used for a small workshop or a chat. Thanks to everyone for taking part – keep polishing your newly acquired skills.

naplavka-dobrocinny-festival-kostelec-na.titulek: Náplavka charity festival in Kostelec nad Orlicí
naplavka-dobrocinny-festival-kostelec-na.perex: The charity festival on the riverside in Kostelec nad Orlicí was incredibly lucky. Not only did the guys ride there, but above all, on a totally rainy day it didn't rain until the end of our…
naplavka-dobrocinny-festival-kostelec-na.obsah:
The charity festival on the riverside in Kostelec nad Orlicí was incredibly lucky. Not only did the guys ride there, but above all, on a totally rainy day it didn't rain until the end of our exhibition. A wall of water the whole way, and sunshine only on the riverside, which ended with the end of the exhibition – and even then it continued only with light drizzle.

After arriving, Vlasta and Lukáš managed to park in the slightly cramped space, get the obstacles out and jump straight into the exhibition. There were plenty of people and they cheered like crazy, so a few bigger jumps came out, maybe right on the edge. By the time we got to the volunteers it started to drizzle lightly, but everything was handled without interruption. Thanks for the invitation.

projekt-startuje.perex: "For a few years now, local guys and riders at races and exhibitions I take part in with colleagues from the TRIALSHOW.cz team have been chasing me to teach them this or that. Until now, priority…
projekt-startuje.obsah:
"For a few years now, local guys and riders at races and exhibitions I take part in with colleagues from the TRIALSHOW.cz team have been chasing me to teach them this or that. Until now, priority went to Trial training in our club and finishing the leisure park in Tehov, but now that everything is up and running, it's time to move from an idea to a final project" Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, founder of the project.

Our gradually growing team of instructors, including names such as Martin Šimůnek, Marek Tryner and Lukáš Valný, aims to teach what some of them have been doing every day for 30 years. Correct riding technique on and off-road is the foundation of everything, and who else should pass it on than Trial riders? We want to offer something different from what's currently available on the market and take a less trodden path in coaching.

Our priority is individual training and training for small groups of riders. We'll also offer standard camps or rides, but only in limited numbers and again for fewer riders.

We're already arranging several workshops across the country which, combined with our exhibition, can be an attractive part of the programme at a sports, municipal or cultural event.

And since we've been working with a number of leading Czech brands for a long time, our goal will be to gradually fill our Shop with products we've tested and know you can rely on.

dvo-testovani-na-spicaku.obsah:
Here's a short invitation from our partner to test DVO shocks and forks at Bike Park Špičák on 30–31 May 2020.

Just turn up and register on site. If we have time and the chance, we'll see you there too.

podporte-katarinu-a-jeji-knihu.perex: UPDATE: Katarína reached her goal, although a bit differently than she wanted. Look forward to it – the book is happening. Katarína has launched a HITHIT campaign to support the publication of her…
podporte-katarinu-a-jeji-knihu.obsah:
UPDATE: Katarína reached her goal, although a bit differently than she wanted. Look forward to it – the book is happening.

Katarína has launched a HITHIT campaign to support the publication of her book.

In brief, what it's all about:

  • New Bikeinstruktor book on mountain bike riding technique
  • The new Bikeinstruktor book will teach you to ride more technically
  • Bikeinstruktor – a book for beginner bikers – is coming out
  • Improve your bike skills with the new Bikeinstruktor book

The book Bikeinstruktor presents technique step by step in a simple, clear way – useful if you want more from your bike than just eating up kilometres. It's a manual for everyone, regardless of age or experience. 

The book is complemented by a large number of detailed illustrations, often broken down into individual sequences. Thanks to its 17 cm x 17 cm format it fits into a backpack or a handbag. 

In it you'll find the basic skills, from balance and riding through corners to jumping. There's also a chapter on building obstacles, first aid, basic bike care and a list of places to ride in the Czech Republic. And there are quite a few of them!

The book was written by Katarína Tóthová based on her experience from racing and coaching. In her biking career she became a two-time national champion in downhill, overall winner of the Czech Downhill Cup, runner-up in four-cross and third in BMX racing. She is a former member of the national team and has extensive experience in dirt, dual, pump track and enduro.

At the moment you can get the book in advance at a discounted price through the crowdfunding campaign on Hithit. There you choose your reward (e.g. a signed book delivered to your home) and the amount of your contribution. You'll receive your reward after the 30-day campaign ends.

Support the project to publish the book. You'll learn to ride more technically and more safely.

exhibicni-vystoupeni-lipova-u-chebu.titulek: Exhibition performance in Lipová near Cheb
exhibicni-vystoupeni-lipova-u-chebu.perex: After quite a while, Vlasta and Lukáš went to see Vláďa Keblůžek in Lipová near Cheb, where the village ball was held. Besides a performance by dancers from StarDance, there was a midnight surprise…
exhibicni-vystoupeni-lipova-u-chebu.obsah: After quite a while, Vlasta and Lukáš went to see Vláďa Keblůžek in Lipová near Cheb, where the village ball was held. Besides a performance by dancers from StarDance, there was a midnight surprise led by the Trialshow team. A great audience atmosphere and a few actors with suicidal tendencies in the role of volunteers helped us a lot. The spectators also dived headfirst into the competition, and thanks to the great surface and high ceiling we managed to show plenty of tricks. Thanks for the invitation – hopefully see you again sometime.

4-tydny-10-exhibic-ci-workshopu.perex: 23/8 – Hovězí+ festival exhibition – charity exhibition in Velešín Light rain before the show didn't stop us, and Vlasta and Tobík performed our classic show at the local festival combined with a…
4-tydny-10-exhibic-ci-workshopu.obsah:
23/8 – Hovězí+ festival exhibition – charity exhibition in Velešín

Light rain before the show didn't stop us, and Vlasta and Tobík performed our classic show at the local festival combined with a contest for the best goulash. The beef one won, of course, and the guys got to taste it. Thanks for the invitation.

30/8 – Exhibition in Valdice 

Luckily we didn't have to go and sit in the local prison – we just had to celebrate the local festival with concerts in a nearby park. The line-up of Vlasta and Michal Budský was unexpectedly joined by our friend Hannes Hermann (multiple German champion), so the locals got to see a truly first-class Trial show.

5/9 – Road trade fair in Pardubice

Once again we were invited to Pardubice for the traditional road trade fair focused on technology and projects related to roads and related services. The exhibition took place by the main stage and was also shown on LED screens around the grounds. Martin Šimůnek and Vlasta had about 20 minutes to demonstrate their sporting art.

6/9 – Triple exhibition in Stonařov, Vraňany and Choceň

Martin Šimůnek and Michal Budský headed to a sports day in Choceň, where they entertained athletes and spectators in 3 short shows. At the same time Vlasta and Lukáš Valný set off for Stonařov for a farewell to summer with a fairly decent turnout. After the show they had to quickly pack the obstacles and bikes and head to Vraňany for the local fair. All exhibitions done – this time Martin and Michal won on number of shows, but Vlasta and Lukáš won on kilometres. Thanks to all the organisers for the invitations.

13/9 – Double exhibition in Říčany and Kunratice

This time we rode on our doorstep. For our home club, together with the club's little ones, we rode a show with 8 riders on the Lázeňská louka meadow in Říčany, where leisure activities and clubs were being presented. We spent some time on the meadow, greeted all our friends and fans, and after training with the kids, Tobík Dolák and Lukáš Valný headed to nearby Kunratice, where a children's day organised by the local theatre took place in the beautiful setting of the chateau park. By the main stage we rode an exhibition, also using the stage, and although it didn't look like it at first, with a decent crowd. The show was originally supposed to be ridden by Martin Šimůnek, who injured his back – we wish him a speedy recovery. Thanks for the invitation.

cyklisticky-zavod-skol-memorial-ferdinan.titulek: Ferdinand Bušta Memorial schools cycling race
cyklisticky-zavod-skol-memorial-ferdinan.perex: After almost 6 years, the organisers of a cycling race for schools and nurseries around Suchdol nad Lužnicí contacted us again. Loads of buses and several hundred kids gathered at the Pískovna…
cyklisticky-zavod-skol-memorial-ferdinan.obsah: After almost 6 years, the organisers of a cycling race for schools and nurseries around Suchdol nad Lužnicí contacted us again. Loads of buses and several hundred kids gathered at the Pískovna campsite, all wanting to grab medals for their school or nursery in individual or team competitions. Part of the programme was an exhibition by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Martin Šimůnek, who showed their Trial art in two shows and organised small competitions for volunteers. Long live cycling – hopefully see you next time.

exhibice-padrtske-plane-modrany-a-vyuka.titulek: Exhibitions at Padrťské pláně, Modřany and coaching
exhibice-padrtske-plane-modrany-a-vyuka.perex: We were really busy this day. Mára Tryner was preparing to coach a small group of enthusiasts. Lukáš Valný and Matouš were ready for the advanced camp, and Martin and Vlasta were doing the rounds…
exhibice-padrtske-plane-modrany-a-vyuka.obsah:
We were really busy this day. Mára Tryner was preparing to coach  a small group of enthusiasts. Lukáš Valný and Matouš were ready for the advanced camp, and Martin and Vlasta were doing the rounds of exhibitions. 

Changes in the weather meant everything got a bit complicated. Mára had to move his lesson. The camp was cancelled (riders could sign up for the next weekend), and the first of the two exhibitions was really for the brave. 

The Brdy forests are a truly beautiful place, and the event itself was on a beautiful large clearing in the middle. Unfortunately the weather wasn't kind to the organisers – it rained practically non-stop and a cold wind blew. Luckily some spectators weren't put off, and the organiser provided enough fire pits to warm up and roast sausages. We tried to run our workshop in the breaks between rain showers, and finally in the late afternoon we got a 15-minute break when even the sun peeked out. We rode a quick exhibition, which ended not only with applause from the spectators but also with a proper downpour. 

After quickly packing up the obstacles we headed for Prague-Modřany, where a crowd at a company party was waiting for us. Luckily without rain by then, we could fully show what we can do and entertain the diverse audience of this multicultural company.

primestsky-tabor-no-2.perex: It was time for the second day camp for young male and female bikers, which we organise with our home club MTB Trial Mraveniště. The weather was spot on and the kids rode even more than last time.…
primestsky-tabor-no-2.obsah:
It was time for the second day camp for young male and female bikers, which we organise with our home club MTB Trial Mraveniště. The weather was spot on and the kids rode even more than last time. Lots of riders came back to us, and it's great to see someone enjoying it so much that they come to two camps in a row.

Instructors Katarína and Matěj and carers Lucka and Lenka put their hearts into it, and you can see the youngsters appreciate it. This time we had no serious injury requiring hospital treatment, and there was time for Trial training for those who had bikes, as well as an Enduro ride on nearby trails for the oldest riders led by Vlasta.

podzimni-den-mlada-boleslav.perex: Another rainy exhibition by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Matouš Balík is history. It took some experience to cope with the gravel, pebbles and mud, but the guys went for it to please all the…
podzimni-den-mlada-boleslav.obsah:
Another rainy exhibition by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Matouš Balík is history. It took some experience to cope with the gravel, pebbles and mud, but the guys went for it to please all the enthusiasts who weren't put off by the rain. The organiser even checked whether it wasn't dangerous to climb on the bike, but after being assured that yes, it's dangerous, but the guys don't care, she gave up. The spectators egged the guys on to a solid 125 cm in the sideways jump, which had to be done instead of the volunteers (nobody would have lain down under the guys in the rain anyway). 

At the same moment Martin Šimůnek and Dominik Budský were battling away at a corporate event in Stará Boleslav. So far we only have photos from the first exhibition, so hopefully Martin will send something.

season-mix-2025-z-cihiho-telefonu.perex: Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček has put together his traditional mix from the past season. Classic old-school riding in his 30th Trial season. There are also a few shots on an E-MTB or a regular bike.…
season-mix-2025-z-cihiho-telefonu.obsah: Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček has put together his traditional mix from the past season. Classic old-school riding in his 30th Trial season. There are also a few shots on an E-MTB or a regular bike.

trenujeme-lvicata.perex: Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček was invited to the show Lvíčata on Czech Television, which this year presents various disciplines through short coaching series with personalities from each sport. To give the…
trenujeme-lvicata.obsah:
Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček was invited to the show Lvíčata on Czech Television, which this year presents various disciplines through short coaching series with personalities from each sport.

To give the coaching a bit of style, they chose the almost cult Nupaky barn, where riders have trained for over 10 years in modest and unconventional conditions. The hall is primarily intended for higher-level riders and isn't very big, but it was enough for filming.

There was some riding too, so hopefully besides the boring theory Vlasta will entertain the boys and girls with his riding over obstacles.

You can find the first episode here: https://decko.ceskatelevize.cz/lvicata (22), and two more episodes will follow.

exhibice-a-workshop-dolni-dubnany.perex: Not far from the Dukovany cooling towers, the village of Dolní Dubňany held a children's day, and the mayor invited us. The beautiful little village hosted firefighters and the Czech police at the event, whom Vlasta and Mára involved in protecting the volunteers we rode over. After the exhibition itself there was a tape-jump competition and an autograph session. The guys also…
exhibice-a-workshop-dolni-dubnany.obsah: Not far from the Dukovany cooling towers, the village of Dolní Dubňany held a children's day, and the mayor invited us. The beautiful little village hosted firefighters and the Czech police at the event, whom Vlasta and Mára involved in protecting the volunteers we rode over. After the exhibition itself there was a tape-jump competition and an autograph session. The guys also lent Trial bikes to interested local youngsters.

bikes4life-ples-exhibice-doksy.perex: This year's first exhibition at a ball, for the motorbike gang of the Bikes4life project, which organises events for bikers and much more. Martin Šimůnek went to the event and also sorted out where…
bikes4life-ples-exhibice-doksy.obsah: This year's first exhibition at a ball, for the motorbike gang of the Bikes4life project, which organises events for bikers and much more. Martin Šimůnek went to the event and also sorted out where to put the obstacles, and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček came with Tobík Dolák from indoor training in Germany. A great bunch of people, a packed venue and plenty of time to show how to fool around and jump on a bike. Thanks for the invitation, ladies and gentlemen.

exhibice-prazske-sluzby.perex: Martin Šimůnek and Petr Manďák have worked together on the Pražské služby event for years. Unfortunately Martin couldn't make it this year, so he asked Vlasta and Lukáš Valný to stand in for him at…
exhibice-prazske-sluzby.obsah: Martin Šimůnek and Petr Manďák have worked together on the Pražské služby event for years. Unfortunately Martin couldn't make it this year, so he asked Vlasta and Lukáš Valný to stand in for him at this mega event at the company's main site. One show in front of the main stage and one by the U-ramp, in heat that was just about right. At the first exhibition the guys were joined by parkour athletes, so the obstacles were used ideally and there was a pile of action all in one place. Thanks for the invitation.

milada-run-2020.perex: When we're not training, we're performing! For the last few years Martin Šimůnek has gone to the running races by the artificial lake Milada – Milada Run. An interesting setting, but terrain full of…
milada-run-2020.obsah:
When we're not training, we're performing!

For the last few years Martin Šimůnek has gone to the running races by the artificial lake Milada – Milada Run. An interesting setting, but terrain full of clods probably wouldn't allow any performance other than Trial. This time Martin invited Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček so he wouldn't have to sweat alone in the heat before the storm, but in the end, despite the rising temperature, it was a really pleasant ride, stretched out with competitions for spectators and jumps over volunteers on the stage. Martin's obstacle setup in green fitted the local environment quite well and is an interesting Trial challenge in itself, and it's a joy to watch how easily Martin handles it, which the spectators appreciated too. 

By coincidence a few visitors from our leisure park in Tehov also came and immediately said hi to the guys. Between exhibitions they got out their full-suspension bikes and rode part of the way around the lake, and of course a swim at the end was a must.

Despite the current situation the turnout was very decent, and we thank the organisers for the invitation – they did an honest piece of work.

primestsky-tabor-na-kolech.perex: We held our club's traditional day camp in Tehov. 30 young male and female bikers could play with us on bikes every day from morning to evening. From basic technique to the pump track, jumps and…
primestsky-tabor-na-kolech.obsah: We held our club's traditional day camp in Tehov. 30 young male and female bikers could play with us on bikes every day from morning to evening. From basic technique to the pump track, jumps and trails in the area. Kája Bedrníková, Štěpán Holý, Marek Tryner and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček put the boys and girls through their paces as instructors and hopefully took their skills a little higher again. The facilities were looked after by Lucka Doláková and Lenka Kabeláčová, to whom big thanks are due.

vibrocore-test.perex: A few weeks ago our Bikeskills.cz team literally got its hands on SPANK handlebars with the so-called VIBROCORE™ core. For us it was a big unknown – we didn't know what to expect from the bars and,…
vibrocore-test.obsah:
A few weeks ago our Bikeskills.cz team literally got its hands on SPANK handlebars with the so-called VIBROCORE™ core. For us it was a big unknown – we didn't know what to expect from the bars and, honestly, didn't have high expectations, because they're simply 'just' handlebars. But after the test everything changed, and now I'm thinking…. WHY NOT? I'll explain everything below.

WHAT IS VIBROCORE™

The principle is simple at first glance. It's a foam of a specific density injected into the cavity of the handlebar, filling about 80% of it. Why not all of it? The ends of the bar are foam-free and ready for possible cutting, so you don't immediately cut into the Vibrocore™ foam.

What's more interesting is that the foam has a fairly high density and is also biodegradable. The filling also increases the overall strength of the bar, which is a nice benefit, but certainly not the main goal SPANK set itself. Only when we talk about vibrations does the key word Vibrocore™ come into play.

HOW VIBROCORE™ WORKS

The first thing that comes to mind is absorbing vibrations while riding. Partly yes and partly no. The purpose of the Vibrocore™ filling is not primarily to absorb vibrations (that's more what suspension forks, shocks etc. on your bike are for), but rather to change the vibration frequency. Absorbing vibrations is a small part of it, but not the main purpose of foam-filled handlebars.

Vibrocore™ was developed over several years into a precisely defined type of foam that changes the frequency of vibrations transmitted from the wheels into the handlebars during riding, and from the handlebars on to the rider's hands and forearms.

You can find an interesting video describing the development of Vibrocore™ here:

VIBRATION FREQUENCY

The frequency while riding an MTB is somewhere between 2 and 200 Hz, which is a fairly wide range. It depends on riding style and the surface you're riding on. However, most common vibrations are somewhere between 5 and 50 Hz. Every handlebar, whether carbon or aluminium, also has its own vibration frequency, so it not only nicely transmits vibrations from the wheels, frame, fork etc., but also produces its own vibration – which, simply put, creates….an amazing storm of vibrations.

According to the SPANK website, which describes the whole Vibrocore™ system in more detail (see: https://spank-ind.com/blogs/news/vibrocore™-the-inside-story), it has been shown that vibrations with a frequency of about 8–50 Hz are dangerous for the hands, hand muscles and forearms and can cause so-called HAVS, which can gradually progress to so-called CECS. I'm not an expert or a doctor, but after a few moments on Google I saw some nasty pictures, and neither idea appeals to me at all.

HAVS (Hand Arm Vibration Syndrome) is also known as white finger syndrome, or Raynaud's syndrome, see: https://www.fyzioklinika.cz/clanky-o-zdravi/raynauduv-syndrom, which often accompanies Raynaud's disease, see: https://cs.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raynaudova_nemoc. White to blue fingertips, poor blood circulation and tissue damage, lack of oxygen up to tissue death. Simply nothing pleasant. This

syndrome often appears in professions where you work with tools that cause stronger vibrations, such as saws, drills, demolition hammers and so on. However, when riding a bike, especially an MTB on forest paths, roots and bumpy tracks, you simply can't avoid vibrations either, and everyone holds the bars firmly enough so they don't fly out of their hands.

CECS (Chronic Exertional Compartment Syndrome) which can be a consequence of HAVS and often appears in motorsport, where a firm grip combined with vibrations from the machine is needed. However, it also appears in bodybuilders and, simply, people who pump iron. Loss of strength in the hands and forearm pain are essentially the result, quite often followed by surgery. Look up photos of CECS – it won't be a pretty sight.

PREVENTING PROBLEMS WITH VIBROCORE™

So the foam inside the handlebar doesn't primarily absorb impacts or vibrations. That's simply not what it's there for – it changes the vibration frequency of the bar and wheel away from the dangerous frequencies mentioned, which can (though of course for some people never will) cause damage to the muscles and nerves of the hands or loss of control of the bike and so on.

WHAT WE TOOK AWAY FROM THE TEST

SPANK handlebars are among the best on the market even without Vibrocore™ foam, which has now reached its 6th generation. The SPANK SPIKE 35 handlebar we tested fits perfectly in the hand, and its oversize 35 mm diameter suggests increased overall stiffness for Enduro or DH.

Now let me go back to the opening thought. When someone has devoted so much attention to something like vibrations, vibration frequency and preventing conditions like HAVS and CECS, why not take the chance to give your hands a 'longer lifespan' without pain and problems? You can believe in Vibrocore™ or not, but even if the bars and their internal foam helped prevent problems by just 10% – problems that may not show up on the first ride but, for example, after a long time or in old age…..then…..WHY NOT?

exhibice-travcice-a-pelhrimovske-rekordy.titulek: Exhibitions in Travčice and the Pelhřimov records
exhibice-travcice-a-pelhrimovske-rekordy.perex: This weekend was again a bit nomadic. Vlasta loaded up young guns Matouš Balík and Tobík Dolák and set off, somewhat unexpectedly, towards Pelhřimov, where another edition of the Pelhřimov Records…
exhibice-travcice-a-pelhrimovske-rekordy.obsah:
This weekend was again a bit nomadic. Vlasta loaded up young guns Matouš Balík and Tobík Dolák and set off, somewhat unexpectedly, towards Pelhřimov, where another edition of the Pelhřimov Records was taking place. Although our team has many registered records, we had never been to this event. Moreover, the invitation came only a few days in advance. On the packed square it looked like rain at first, but in the end we rode the whole show in sunshine right on the main stage, and we even managed to use our trailer for jumping over and dropping off. People enjoyed the show and hopefully we'll be invited to future editions.

But the Pelhřimov exhibition might not have happened at all – it was only thanks to Martin Šimůnek's freed-up schedule that the Travčice exhibition worked out too. Martin and unicyclist Dominik also had a packed crowd, even though it was just a small village sports event. They also definitely sent more photos than Vlasta's part of the team, but hopefully something else will arrive.

Before the exhibition Vlasta went to check out the new Rock Machine bikes, which got new colours, and a luxurious new Enduro and E-bike were on display too. Thanks to LSK for the invitation.

prvni-camp-za-nami.perex: We have our first camp dedicated to women and girls who wanted to improve their technique and style on the bike behind us. Almost ideal sunny weather – meaning neither cold nor hot – underlined the…
prvni-camp-za-nami.obsah:
We have our first camp dedicated to women and girls who wanted to improve their technique and style on the bike behind us. Almost ideal sunny weather – meaning neither cold nor hot – underlined the relaxed atmosphere and gave everyone the energy to progress on the pump track, in the skills centre and on a ride in the surrounding forests.

Katarína and Vlasta were available, as well as Mára and Lukáš. The latter dived into the action literally headfirst, and besides an exhibition after lunch he also demonstrated the master carpenter's mistake – a silly crash. He came away with a bruised finger.

Lunch was also sorted successfully, and Mára's workshop took place in relaxed mode. All day everyone had the chance to compete for MALOJA jerseys donated by LEVELSPORTKONCEPT. The condition for winning wasn't to be the best but to make the biggest progress. In the end the instructors' vote produced two winners – congratulations.

We look forward to the next camp for intermediate men on 23 May. We're also preparing a trail version for women and men.

In the meantime Vlasta and club colleagues Petr Jeřicha and Martin Vavřinec popped over to Czech Television for the programme Náš venkov to present the Kolovraty – Mnichovice cycle path.

trojita-exhibicni-naloz-pankrac-doksy-le.titulek: A triple exhibition load – Pankrác / Doksy / Letňany
trojita-exhibicni-naloz-pankrac-doksy-le.perex: After several days of individual training, a Saturday on the Trial bike and 3 exhibitions awaited me and the guys. It started in the morning in Prague at the Craft Run, which happened to be supported…
trojita-exhibicni-naloz-pankrac-doksy-le.obsah:
After several days of individual training, a Saturday on the Trial bike and 3 exhibitions awaited me and the guys. It started in the morning in Prague at the Craft Run, which happened to be supported by Gatorade. Here, for now, just with my colleague Lukáš Valný. You could tell people were a bit scared of the weather, but as it warmed up the number of visitors grew, and our show after Honza Weber already had a pretty decent crowd.

We quickly threw everything into the car and set off to meet Martin Šimůnek in Doksy near Česká Lípa, where the traditional meet of Škoda cars and car tuning was taking place. The organisers slowly squeezed us through the packed camp to the spot where the main participants of our show were already gathering – kids from a children's home for abused and neglected children. Hopefully Martin, Lukáš and I brought a little joy into their lives. I mustn't forget my son Marty, who rode his first exhibition here, and Nikolka and Elinka, who helped and took photos the whole time. 

The exhibition ran long, so we had barely packed the obstacles before we were on the way to Letňany in Prague, where the Pivobraní beer festival was on. In a really packed atmosphere we launched an exhibition for all the beer lovers and fans of the various goodies on offer at the stalls. This time we rode the exhibition at a slightly more action-packed pace.

V.

mcr-masters-v-cyklistice-prazske-sluzby-.titulek: Czech Masters Cycling Championships, Pražské služby, Otovice festival and the festival in Pržno
mcr-masters-v-cyklistice-prazske-sluzby-.perex: 4 exhibitions in one day is a lot even for us, especially in just two teams. Michal Budský and Marek Tryner took a trip to far-off Pržno, where they enjoyed the local festival in front of a great…
mcr-masters-v-cyklistice-prazske-sluzby-.obsah:
4 exhibitions in one day is a lot even for us, especially in just two teams. Michal Budský and Marek Tryner took a trip to far-off Pržno, where they enjoyed the local festival in front of a great audience.


Martin Šimůnek and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček with his complete kids' line-up headed Prague – Sokolov – Karlovy Vary. First up was Pražské služby, where together with the guys from Flow parkour they rode an exhibition in front of loads of spectators, who weren't put off even by the 29-degree scorcher.

Next was the Czech Masters Road Cycling Championship organised by Cyklokili, with the awards ceremony on Sokolov square. A beautifully organised event, limited only by road closures on the course due to reconstruction work. And of course, who's a better spectator than a cyclist 🙂.

Last up was Otovice near Karlovy Vary. A really polished village, where the locals put on a great event full of performances and rock music. We could barely drag the obstacles out of the trailer by then, but we got fired up and the spectators were incredible. We couldn't deprive them of crashes either – this time, unusually, it was Martin Šimůnek who took care of that. In the heat of battle he even flew onto his backside from over a metre and sat on the wireless microphone :) Even a world champion falls during a show once every 20 years. But the exhibition was successfully completed.

exhibice-ples-sportovnich-klubu-kralupy-.titulek: Sports clubs' ball exhibition – Kralupy nad Vltavou
exhibice-ples-sportovnich-klubu-kralupy-.perex: The sports clubs' ball was a big surprise. 600+ spectators, the great setting of the cultural centre hall and loads of side programme for sportsmen and sportswomen. Vlasta, Lukáš Valný and Tobík…
exhibice-ples-sportovnich-klubu-kralupy-.obsah: The sports clubs' ball was a big surprise. 600+ spectators, the great setting of the cultural centre hall and loads of side programme for sportsmen and sportswomen. Vlasta, Lukáš Valný and Tobík Dolák even had plenty of space backstage for a warm-up, which had its own spectators. The waxed floor was a bit of a struggle, and there were a few crowd-pleasing crashes (luckily on the flat and harmless). After the classic intro on the obstacles we moved on to the male and female volunteers. The highlight was a riders vs walkers high-jump battle. It was no surprise that on the slippery floor the jumper without a bike won, but nobody expected it to be a rugby player. Thanks for the warm welcome and the cheering – hopefully we'll meet on a bigger scale at a summer event.

exhibicni-maraton-kluku-z-bikeskills.titulek: An exhibition marathon by the BIKESKILLS guys
exhibicni-maraton-kluku-z-bikeskills.perex: Here are a few reports on the travels of our BIKESKILLS instructors, who don't just teach but keep spreading joy at Trial exhibitions all over the Czech Republic. When it's allowed, that is :) 30…
exhibicni-maraton-kluku-z-bikeskills.obsah:
Here are a few reports on the travels of our BIKESKILLS instructors, who don't just teach but keep spreading joy at Trial exhibitions all over the Czech Republic. When it's allowed, that is :)

30 Aug 2020 – Children's Olympics – Struhařov

Rain all day, but beautiful weather exactly for the moment of the exhibition. As they say, more luck than judgement for Lukáš Valný and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, who set off for a quick exhibition literally through the forest from where they live. The kids were going wild in the rain at the Olympics, so the performance by our team and club – in nice weather, too – was a lovely change. For us it was a warm-up before the upcoming marathon of exhibitions in September.

6 Sep 2020 – Brno Sports Day – KS Omega Brno

Marek Tryner kicked off a series of exhibitions in Brno, where he finished his studies a few years ago. Little Jířa Sehnal appeared alongside him as a guest, and together they entertained the boys and girls at the event.

11 Sep 2020 – Road trade fair exhibition – Pardubice

Martin Šimůnek and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček met up in Pardubice at a trade fair focused on road transport. In beautiful sunny weather the grounds of the local services company attracted a real crowd of visitors who weren't afraid of the coronavirus and appreciated the guys' performance, which somewhat blocked the space in front of the main stage. There was also an interview for local TV – the usual :)

12 Sep 2020 – 3 exhibitions in one day – Rouské / Nový Bor / Prague-Zeleneč

Today, for the first time this year, we got out all our mobile parks and vehicles. Marek Tryner and Lukáš Valný went to the village of Rouské (South Moravia), where they showed a bit of Trial action at the local fair, having first managed to enjoy some trails on mountain bikes. Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Michal Budský set off with the trailer to Nový Bor, where Martin Šimůnek was already waiting at the employee days of Crystalex. On the company premises employees and their families had loads of attractions and, besides concerts, two shows by our team. Martin Šimůnek then went to a smaller event (unfortunately we don't know where yet :)), and Vlasta and Michal drove at the maximum permitted speed to Prague-Zeleneč, where a children's day was being held on the local meadows. They didn't have much energy left, but Michal fired up a bottle-hitting contest when jumping off the trailer, and Vlasta, despite a brace on his leg, tried to push his sideways jump record. He ended at 127 cm over the tape (3 cm below the official Czech record), which isn't bad after 6 knee operations. 

13 Sep 2020 – Exhibition at the fair – Škvorec

As is often the case, we don't ride many exhibitions near our homes. We're usually booked from further away. The same actually happened now – Martin Šimůnek was originally supposed to ride the exhibition, but by coincidence it ended up on our club and team shoulders :) The local fair by the stage became a Trial park for a few hours for Vlasta, Marek, Lukáš and Matouš Balík. But the club's little ones also came along to watch or test the test course we'd put together. 

18 and 19 Sep 2020 – Říčany town festival and an individual course in Trutnov

Normally we don't mention individual training much in our reports, but we'll make an exception as part of this marathon. Marek Tryner was coaching in Prague, while Vlasta was on the Trutnov trails as part of the BIKESKILLS project. Vlasta then went wild with Lukáš Valný and young Mrlik from the club at the town festival in Říčany, where poor attendance was very noticeable – people were evidently afraid. Normally this festival is a very popular event in the Říčany area. The exhibition spot was deliberately chosen on the local cycle path away from the main event, so there were practically only spectators while the peloton on historic bikes passed, but on the other hand we had the chance to ride more.

bikeskills-campy-2.perex: We held a camp for women, girls and female bikers, where Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček coached alongside Katarína Tóthová a group of enthusiastic female bikers who wanted to improve and enjoy off-road…
bikeskills-campy-2.obsah: We held a camp for women, girls and female bikers, where Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček coached alongside Katarína Tóthová a group of enthusiastic female bikers who wanted to improve and enjoy off-road riding more. There was some egging on at the steps and descents too. The great weather only underlined the pleasant atmosphere of the camp.

exhibice-sadska-aneb-cary-v-topu.titulek: Exhibition in Sadská, or 'Lines on Top'
exhibice-sadska-aneb-cary-v-topu.perex: The exhibitions in Sadská are a beautiful example of a community event organised by the cultural centre and the local volunteer fire brigade There was nothing to fault about the event – beautiful…
exhibice-sadska-aneb-cary-v-topu.obsah:
The exhibitions in Sadská are a beautiful example of a community event organised by the cultural centre and the local volunteer fire brigade

There was nothing to fault about the event – beautiful weather, active spectators and even the deputy mayor, pulled out by mistake as a volunteer.

Hopefully our riding by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Lukáš Valný and Ondra Nenadál entertained kids and adults – thanks for the invitation.

giro-ditalia-exhibice.perex: You don't turn down an invitation from a partner – and certainly not when it's to the second-biggest cycling race in the world, the Giro d'Italia, whose first stages were ridden in Budapest. Thanks…
giro-ditalia-exhibice.obsah:
You don't turn down an invitation from a partner – and certainly not when it's to the second-biggest cycling race in the world, the Giro d'Italia, whose first stages were ridden in Budapest. Thanks to Levelsportkoncept – specifically POC, the brand I've ridden for for most of my sporting career – my colleague Marek Tryner and I had the chance to experience the atmosphere of such a big event and watch road cycling from the front line.

The exhibition itself took place in a beautiful central park near the start. We had both our team trailer and partners' branded obstacles on site. The sound system was occupied by the broadcast on the big screen, but in the end we found a way to lure spectators to our exhibitions and do a bit of hosting in English. Riding the obstacles was also great training, which sometimes got out of hand and we rode for a few hours straight.

Everything hurts, but hopefully both POC and the spectators were happy – for them it was a very unusual thing compared with the time trials of the guys on road bikes.

terminy-campu-pro-holky-i-chlapi-jsou-ve.titulek: Camp dates for women and men are out
terminy-campu-pro-holky-i-chlapi-jsou-ve.perex: The Bikeskills camps are out and we hope to see you on the bike as often as possible. The number of exhibitions our riders do slows us down a bit, but hopefully we've managed to get most events into…
terminy-campu-pro-holky-i-chlapi-jsou-ve.obsah:
The Bikeskills camps are out and we hope to see you on the bike as often as possible. The number of exhibitions our riders do slows us down a bit, but hopefully we've managed to get most events into our yellow calendar. We may add one more spring date – please give us time. Even so, we're offering a third more camps than last year, which will hopefully fully satisfy you and take your technique to the next level.

Of course you can also use our individual courses and put together a small group of friends. We'll take you through challenging trails and to secret spots.

If you'd like to sign up for a camp and don't see it in the camp list yet, write to info@bikeskills.cz. We announce camps gradually.

primestsky-tabor-a-exhibice-loucna-a-zul.titulek: Day camp and exhibitions in Loučná and Žulová
primestsky-tabor-a-exhibice-loucna-a-zul.perex: We have a tough week behind us. Unfortunately it started badly with Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček's injury in a bike park (ribs, sternum and spine). Luckily Vlasta walked away on his own feet, but still,…
primestsky-tabor-a-exhibice-loucna-a-zul.obsah:
We have a tough week behind us. Unfortunately it started badly with Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček's injury in a bike park (ribs, sternum and spine). Luckily Vlasta walked away on his own feet, but still, not great. Thank goodness it didn't jeopardise the bike day camp during the week, and 25 boys and girls could throw themselves into improving on bikes under the supervision of Bikeskills instructors and capable carers from our club. Kids come back to us year after year and you can see their progress – including boys who win Enduro races for the youngest. 

At the weekend Martin Šimůnek and Lukáš Valný headed to exhibitions in Loučná (workshop with a show) and Žulová in the Jeseníky mountains (concerts at the town festival). The guys worked their socks off in the prevailing heat.

exhibice-kluku-z-bikeskills-na-zavode-ko.titulek: Exhibition by the Bikeskills guys at the Around the Republic race
exhibice-kluku-z-bikeskills-na-zavode-ko.perex: The very idea of riding around the whole Czech Republic by bike is exhausting for me, and respect to everyone who voluntarily signs up for this event as a rider. Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Mára Tryner…
exhibice-kluku-z-bikeskills-na-zavode-ko.obsah:
The very idea of riding around the whole Czech Republic by bike is exhausting for me, and respect to everyone who voluntarily signs up for this event as a rider. Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Mára Tryner and Matouš Balík from our club were riders too – but luckily only with a Trial show, which they put on at the start in the morning.

In half an hour they showed both classic Trial and overcoming obstacles on regular mountain bikes. Hopefully it whetted the participants' appetite a bit and they decided that rather than risk the obstacles, they'll do those 1,400 kilometres.

Thanks for the invitation – hopefully everyone gets through those few days safely. From the exhibition the guys went straight to the Trutnov trails, where they flew down the black routes – Ptačí perspektiva deserves special praise. It has some really well-made rocky sections, though you could figure out a few harder lines there :)

251062-2.perex: Vlasta reports on building the trail in Říčany: As I wrote earlier, I was approached to build the Olivova trail in my home town of Říčany. There was a very limited budget, and therefore a challenge…
251062-2.obsah:
Vlasta reports on building the trail in Říčany:

As I wrote earlier, I was approached to build the Olivova trail in my home town of Říčany. There was a very limited budget, and therefore a challenge to do something for the community. I'm an organiser and I have no problem building a natural trail, but a flow trail with jumps is outside my field. After selecting possible builders we went for Kuba Vencl, who used to ride there with local Honza Tóth, and who even got a machine operator's licence for the project. Everything important was sorted, and construction started a few weeks ago. The weather sometimes threw a spanner in the works, but the guys worked fast and the few problems along the way were solved quickly. Today is probably the last day of construction, finishing the surface. I'm attaching a few photos that I think will please every biker's eye. Our club should take over management of the area, and the Bikeskills project will have another place to train on the Tehov – Říčany route.

For next year I'm preparing two events, one of which will be the season opener and the official opening of the trail, which won't happen this year anymore. It will include a workshop, a dirt jump exhibition and a Trial exhibition.

exhibice-na-stanovani-v-chvalovicich-s-w.titulek: Exhibition at the camping festival in Chvalovice with a pump track workshop
exhibice-na-stanovani-v-chvalovicich-s-w.perex: A really tricky event. A bit of confusion in the programme – at the organiser's request we tried to set off half a day earlier – wouldn't have mattered much. If we can, we try to accommodate…
exhibice-na-stanovani-v-chvalovicich-s-w.obsah: A really tricky event. A bit of confusion in the programme – at the organiser's request we tried to set off half a day earlier – wouldn't have mattered much. If we can, we try to accommodate everyone. But a burst tyre on the car delayed us by almost 4 hours. Luckily we had time in reserve, so in the end the exhibition simply took place at the agreed time in the nice leisure park in Chvalovice, led by Vlasta and Lukáš with the little ones. Katarína Tóthová, thanks to our mobile sound system, took care of a workshop on the nearby pump track.

zehnani-kol-svatba-bikeru-a-dny-bezpecno.titulek: Bike blessing, a bikers' wedding and Safety Days
zehnani-kol-svatba-bikeru-a-dny-bezpecno.perex: On the first weekend of May we had a double exhibition at the Bike Blessing in Dolní Branná, where we rode two shows on a newly built playground near the local church. Together with Martin Šimůnek we…
zehnani-kol-svatba-bikeru-a-dny-bezpecno.obsah:
On the first weekend of May we had a double exhibition at the Bike Blessing in Dolní Branná, where we rode two shows on a newly built playground near the local church. Together with Martin Šimůnek we prepared a workshop with an obstacle course for the local kids, and despite the initial rain quite a lot of locals and visitors came. 

Straight from Dolní Branná we headed for Most, where two bikers were getting married at the Rudolice farmstead. Dad's a cyclist and the kids ride trails and bike parks. A few guests were slightly tipsy, but most were saving themselves for our surprise, arranged by the bride's mother. All the best in life to the newlyweds and to the wedding guests who lay down under our wheels 🙂

The following weekend safety was on the agenda in front of a shopping centre in Teplice. This big event, attended by practically all organisations focused on safety and the rescue services, has an almost 20-year tradition, and you could tell from the turnout. Events at shopping centres are usually a bit boring, but a decent number of people came here and the organisation was high quality too. So Martin Šimůnek and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček rode slightly sharper and longer shows. The first had light rain at the end, but the second was spot on.

exhibice-pro-cement-hranice-chocenicky-f.titulek: Exhibitions for Cement Hranice, the Chocenice festival and Forestry Day
exhibice-pro-cement-hranice-chocenicky-f.perex: Split into 3 teams, we covered a large part of our beautiful country. Martin Šimůnek headed to Ralsko, where several tens of thousands of visitors gather at the mega event Forestry Day to check out…
exhibice-pro-cement-hranice-chocenicky-f.obsah:
Split into 3 teams, we covered a large part of our beautiful country. Martin Šimůnek headed to Ralsko, where several tens of thousands of visitors gather at the mega event Forestry Day to check out the machinery and everything connected with the forest. It also includes a rich side programme, which traditionally includes an exhibition by Martin and our team.


Michal Budský and Lukáš Valný, on the other hand, crossed the whole country to Hranice, where Cement Hranice was celebrating a respectable 70 years since its founding. It had one big advantage – the obstacles were already prepared on site, so the guys got to ride on concrete blocks and bags of cement.


Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Mára Tryner went to Chocenice near Plzeň with our Kabeláč kids' selection, jumping at a small village festival. Everyone has a technical problem sometimes, and this time it was us – or rather Mára Tryner, whose chain tensioner spring snapped. Luckily a spring was found on Nikolka Kabeláčová's bike, and she took on the role of photographer. Judging by the feedback the event went great, and the beautiful weather helped bring in a big turnout.

terminy-akci-2021.perex: We've prepared the dates of the events our team is planning for this year. Of course everything depends on the easing of current restrictions – camps and day camps will be possible with at least 10…
terminy-akci-2021.obsah:
We've prepared the dates of the events our team is planning for this year. Of course everything depends on the easing of current restrictions – camps and day camps will be possible with at least 10 riders / participants, or ideally the planned 20.

We know that big events like Říčanské Šlapačky are really up in the air, but smaller sports-focused events should have a better chance of success. Unfortunately we've had to cut back our plans for camps in Moravia, but we've added a few dates of classic one-day camps, which we'll expand with different levels and locations on the trails.

We once again want to pass on some of our knowledge of technical riding and the pump track to learning-hungry women – and, for 2021, to their male counterparts too.

Due to great success we're also planning kids' day camps focused on MTB and the pump track.

We'll publish the camp programme, prices and other details as soon as possible.

bikeskills-campy-a-exhibice.perex: This year's first weekend with several events – there'll be more of those this year. On a rainy Saturday we held a slightly reduced Bikeskills camp for men, which had to be interrupted in the…
bikeskills-campy-a-exhibice.obsah:
This year's first weekend with several events – there'll be more of those this year. On a rainy Saturday we held a slightly reduced Bikeskills camp for men, which had to be interrupted in the afternoon because the riders were soaked – even waterproof jackets couldn't take any more water. Sunday turned out much better, and a bigger group of women enjoyed the sunshine. We rode a few new spots in the area and the progress was very decent. Just before the end of the camp, Vlasta, the only male disturbing element, broke away and set off with Lukáš Valný and Matouš Balík for a big event by the Miskovice lookout tower. 

More than a thousand people came to celebrate witch-burning night, enjoy the competitions and concerts and check out our team's new obstacle setup. Thanks for the cooperation, and to Aleš Matoušek for co-hosting and DJing the whole event.

harfa-sport-zahajeni-bikove-sezony.perex: Vlasta rode an exhibition for the cycling and leisure shop Harfa Sport in cooperation with Levelsportkoncept (our team partner). Thanks to that he got to try out a loaned Superior bike, which he then…
harfa-sport-zahajeni-bikove-sezony.obsah: Vlasta rode an exhibition for the cycling and leisure shop Harfa Sport in cooperation with Levelsportkoncept (our team partner). Thanks to that he got to try out a loaned Superior bike, which he then used to ride down and up the stairs in the shop, as well as for a bit of hopping on the obstacles, to show that XC bikes from Superior can take something too. Since time for practice on the bike was limited and he hadn't ridden it in, for the jumps over volunteers he reached for his Trial bike. Among the guests, Olympian Ondřej Synek lay down under Vlasta. Visitors could see the new collections of clothing, accessories and bikes for the coming bike season.

zaver-prazdnin-na-cestach.titulek: End of the summer holidays on the road
zaver-prazdnin-na-cestach.perex: The end of the holidays was a bit hectic. We got to visit a few interesting festivals and town celebrations and coached several enthusiastic male and female bikers. Martin Šimůnek worked with Míra…
zaver-prazdnin-na-cestach.obsah:
The end of the holidays was a bit hectic. We got to visit a few interesting festivals and town celebrations and coached several enthusiastic male and female bikers.

Martin Šimůnek worked with Míra Brunclík at the village festival in Kvítkov and couldn't praise the local audience enough – after all, it was practically on their doorstep. 

Vlasta, Tobík Dolák and Lukáš Valný, on the other hand, went to a festival in Kaplice, where unfortunately there was a bit of organisational noise. Simply put, plans work until they don't, and here it didn't work out. Anyway, after agreeing with the event organisers, a slot was found between bands where we could perform. To our credit, we drew the biggest crowd in front of the main stage of the whole afternoon. 

On the last day of the summer holidays Vlasta, Nikolka Kabeláčová and moto-trial rider Dalibor Šulc headed to the beer festival in Jevišovice, where in 33 degrees they rode a 40-minute exhibition followed by a workshop in the beautiful smallest town in South Moravia. It has to be said they have a really beautiful historic centre. We also coped with sloping terrain and made good use of our team sound system, since we operated as an independent unit. Thanks to everyone for the invitations – we look forward to the September events.

je-libo-traily.perex: As the article published in Říčansko suggests, we're now looking into building trails around Říčany, which would free up forest paths for walkers and slightly discourage the building of some illegal…
je-libo-traily.obsah:
As the article published in Říčansko suggests, we're now looking into building trails around Říčany, which would free up forest paths for walkers and slightly discourage the building of some illegal trails – because why do something illegally when it could be done together and legally?

Moreover, when it comes to trails, Říčany – a town that lives for cycling – is missing something like this. The route study was prepared by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, and it looks like recreational riders could enjoy it, as well as – thanks to smaller side lines – those who can ride.

dny-javornicka-lesnicky-den-solfest-soko.titulek: Javornicko Days, Forestry Day, Solfest, Sokolov, Prague 15, a Trial course and a natural disaster
dny-javornicka-lesnicky-den-solfest-soko.perex: This week was one of the most demanding I can imagine as a rider and organiser. Thursday started with a morning Trial course for guys who want to fulfil their biker dream and peek behind the scenes of Trial. In the afternoon we headed to Prague 15, where a kids' pump track was being opened with the city leadership in attendance, and my son Márty and I…
dny-javornicka-lesnicky-den-solfest-soko.obsah: This week was one of the most demanding I can imagine as a rider and organiser. Thursday started with a morning Trial course for guys who want to fulfil their biker dream and peek behind the scenes of Trial. In the afternoon we headed to Prague 15, where a kids' pump track was being opened with the city leadership in attendance, and my son Márty and I rode a father-and-son exhibition there. On Saturday our team split into 3: Michal Budský and Tobík Dolák rode Forestry Day in Ralsko, Martin Šimůnek and Dominik Budský did an exhibition and workshop in Sokolov, and Lukáš Valný and I went to Javornicko Days, where we rode just before Imagine Diamonds. We finished riding and practically right after us it started raining. Unfortunately, when we got home we found out that a windstorm had swept through the Říčany area and Tehov and flooded our houses/gardens. The parks we manage were hit too, so what followed was dealing with our caretaker duties. On Sunday Martin Šimůnek, Vlasta and Lukáš Valný headed to Solnice for the local Solfest festival, where in incredible heat they rode an exhibition and handed out a few drinks. After returning, more dealing with the aftermath of the windstorm – and that awaits us all next week too.

campy-pro-holky-a-chlapi-no-1.titulek: Camps for women and men no. 1
campy-pro-holky-a-chlapi-no-1.perex: Excellent weather and turnout, a relaxed atmosphere and the desire to improve were the cornerstones of our camps. All participants tried not only to take in everything we wanted to pass on but also…
campy-pro-holky-a-chlapi-no-1.obsah: Excellent weather and turnout, a relaxed atmosphere and the desire to improve were the cornerstones of our camps. All participants tried not only to take in everything we wanted to pass on but also to overcome their fear. Of course, all with regard to the participants' bikes and their current abilities. The progress by the end of the camp was more than visible, and every single rider deserves praise. In the men's camp we made an exception and took on one mini guy with his dad, who was backed up by our team mascot Marty Kabeláč.

obecni-slavnosti-vchynice-a-individualni.titulek: Vchynice village festival and individual courses
obecni-slavnosti-vchynice-a-individualni.perex: The start of the summer holidays was mainly about individual courses for older enduro riders and young guns, which Vlasta took charge of. On Saturday he and Martin Šimůnek with a bunch of kids went…
obecni-slavnosti-vchynice-a-individualni.obsah:
The start of the summer holidays was mainly about individual courses for older enduro riders and young guns, which Vlasta took charge of. On Saturday he and Martin Šimůnek with a bunch of kids went training in Šimi's stomping ground (the beaches of Lake Mácha), where they crushed Martin's traditional spots, and then set off for the village of Vchynice, to the newly renovated village barn, which the locals have turned into a community centre. 

A beautiful place and luxurious weather were ideal for an exhibition of more than 30 minutes, where both the kids and Vlasta with Martin performed for the locals. We managed a few competitions, drops off the trailer, a jump onto a car and jumps over volunteers, and after the exhibition the kids could catch sweets falling on ribbons from a plane.

exhibice-sportovni-odpoledne-rohozna.perex: We were supposed to ride the exhibition in Rohozná before Covid, but unfortunately you can't control an epidemic and the event was postponed several times. Before the exhibition itself we visited the…
exhibice-sportovni-odpoledne-rohozna.obsah:
We were supposed to ride the exhibition in Rohozná before Covid, but unfortunately you can't control an epidemic and the event was postponed several times. Before the exhibition itself we visited the Trial park in Hamry nad Sázavou, where we did a light training session that within an hour turned into cold, cloudy, windy weather. We'd given it our all, so there was no point risking injury and we set off for Rohozná.

This village of 300–400 inhabitants evidently knows how to have fun, and they'd prepared a pretty nice programme with the facilities of the local football club, which was playing its match when we arrived.

When we arrived the weather still looked good, but unfortunately the tradition of the last 3 weeks repeated itself, and Vlasta and Lukáš Valný with little Marty Kabeláč waited in the car for the rain to stop. After an hour it was clear it wasn't going to pass, and the spectators wanted to be entertained. And since the guys were the highlight of the programme, there was nothing left but to pluck up courage and try to show some Trial art even in the rain. Luckily it all went without a big crash, even though the grass and our obstacles were slippery as ice. 

The spectators were great and praised the whole team for both the performance and the attitude. We look forward to Rohozná again in 2023.

olympiada-skolek.perex: At a day's notice we were asked for an exhibition at the traditional Nursery School Olympics in Prague, hosted by the school and nursery in Měcholupy. The organisation was in the hands of Radek…
olympiada-skolek.obsah:
At a day's notice we were asked for an exhibition at the traditional Nursery School Olympics in Prague, hosted by the school and nursery in Měcholupy. The organisation was in the hands of Radek Zavřel from the Czech Olympic Committee, so we knew what we were getting into. Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček took on the show, and since the event was for nurseries, he also brought his youngest rider Marty Kabeláč (with a proper excuse note for nursery, of course).

The kids gave it their all, and after their performance Vlasta and Márty showed them a bit of Trial art on the trailer and obstacles. Vlasta rode on top of them, Márty rode under them, and the teachers wanted to take Márty into their class straight away :)

sidekick-od-e-13-novinka-pro-2025.perex: e*thirteen, a pioneer in mountain bike technology, is introducing an innovation being called a revolution in cycling: Sidekick hubs feature an innovative mechanism that disconnects the drivetrain…
sidekick-od-e-13-novinka-pro-2025.obsah:
e*thirteen, a pioneer in mountain bike technology, is introducing an innovation being called a revolution in cycling:

Sidekick hubs feature an innovative mechanism that disconnects the drivetrain from the rear wheel when coasting. This unique feature, together with an adjustable engagement dead zone, eliminates pedal kickback, significantly improving suspension performance and comfort on full-suspension bikes. At the same time, chain slap and drivetrain vibrations are filtered out, ensuring a quiet and smooth ride.

Grappler Flux and Sylvan wheels use the Sidekick hub system with a construction for greater comfort and traction without compromising lateral stiffness and strength. These wheels are optimised for Aggressive-Trail, Enduro and Downhill and are ideal for mountain bikes and class 1 e-bikes.

You'll soon find the products in our e-shop.

Is Sidekick for me?

Let's find out…

On Monday we launched the Sidekick hubs and wheels, and you had lots of questions. We're happy to answer everything from the most common to the most mundane!

All FAQs

Sidekick video

E-bike compatibility?

YES! Sidekick hubs and wheels are fully suited to e-bikes. They have a steel axle and large bearings that can handle the extra weight and motor torque. Flux rims are rated to the ASTM5 standard and meet our e*spec specifications for strength and durability. And there are other benefits too!

More

I'm not a professional downhiller. Is Sidekick still for me?

YES! Sidekick hubs benefit riders of all skill levels, not just professional downhillers. By eliminating pedal kickback at its source, Sidekick hubs let the suspension work as designed and improve traction, handling and comfort. The result is a quieter, more efficient ride with less fatigue, especially in demanding terrain.

More

Does a low-engagement hub do the same thing?

No, low-engagement hubs vary in the amount of engagement every time. With Sidekick hubs the rider gets consistency, because the pusher mechanism ensures a guaranteed amount of engagement dead zone.

More

Available configurations?

Sidekick hubs are offered in:

For All Mountain and Enduro with XD™, MS™ and HG™ freehubs, 148x12 mm and 157x12 mm in 28h and 32h are available.

For downhill with Mini-HG or our integrated 7-speed cassette in 157x12 mm 32h.

www.ethirteen.com

exhibicni-vystoupeni-bikes4life-sosnova.perex: A bikers' ball always gets wild, and because we know that, this year's first exhibition was ridden by the two chief wild ones, Martin Šimůnek and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček. The journey to Sosnová was…
exhibicni-vystoupeni-bikes4life-sosnova.obsah:
A bikers' ball always gets wild, and because we know that, this year's first exhibition was ridden by the two chief wild ones, Martin Šimůnek and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček.

The journey to Sosnová was a bit of a lottery with freshly fallen snow, but the warm welcome on site and a hall packed to the brim fired the guys up for an almost 30-minute show for the motorbike survivors of last season. Martin complained about a sore back, but he still put on an incredible hosted show that hopefully pleased every lover of handlebars.

exhibice-na-otevreni-pumpu-v-caslavi.titulek: Exhibition at the pump track opening in Čáslav
exhibice-na-otevreni-pumpu-v-caslavi.perex: This time the weather was kind, and the team of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Michal Budský and Márty Kabeláč could fire off ...
exhibice-na-otevreni-pumpu-v-caslavi.obsah:
Probably the last outdoor exhibition of the year is history. This time the weather was kind, and the team of Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Michal Budský and Márty Kabeláč could fire off exhibition tricks in front of the town leadership on the asphalt surface near the pump track.

The pump track itself was created by digging out soil for a pond by the cycle path and is made of earth with fine gravel on the surface. Thanks to its proximity to the cycle path and the National Agricultural Museum, there will be no shortage of visitors. Besides our team, the guys from BMX Pardubice came to test it, and after the show Michal and Márty joined them and tested it like their lives depended on it.

The event organisers are also talented photographers, so this time we have exceptionally great photos from the event.

zdechovice-a-straz-u-tachova-exhibice.titulek: Exhibitions in Zdechovice and Stráž near Tachov
zdechovice-a-straz-u-tachova-exhibice.perex: This Saturday we didn't ride a record number of exhibitions, but we equalled our record for the number of riders from our team plus guests. Stráž near Tachov, where the town festival was held, was…
zdechovice-a-straz-u-tachova-exhibice.obsah:
This Saturday we didn't ride a record number of exhibitions, but we equalled our record for the number of riders from our team plus guests. 

Stráž near Tachov, where the town festival was held, was covered by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Mára Tryner. The festival was relatively small, but with an interesting programme featuring a group of gunners with cannons. You don't want to hear that roar and feel the pressure wave from the cannonade :) The guys were accompanied by our smallest rider, Marty Kabeláč.

A noticeably bigger event was the Zdechovice festival, where Martin Šimůnek, Lukáš Valný and Matouš Balík went for Trial, together with Dalibor Šulc for moto-trial and, as if that weren't enough, parkour athlete Marek from Artmoving. In 3 shows and workshops the guys entertained the large audience of the Zdechovice festival.

And finally, a thank you and a bit of showing off of a new addition to the team garage. Besides a new Crewkerz Trial bike, Vlasta has finally renewed his full-suspension bike after more than 6–7 years. A CUBE frame thanks to our cooperation with the brand of the same name, and complete components from the range of our partner Levelsportkoncept. On the bike you'll find exclusive products from E-thirteen, Spank and DVO suspension. The wheel size changed too, from 27.5” to 29”. Marek Tryner, by contrast, updated his TREK Remedy to the 2022 version. Martin Šimůnek brought the same bike plus a CUBE e-bike.
