levelsportkoncept-testing-by-bikeskills.perex: Last weekend we had the chance to test components from our partner Levelsportkoncept.cz – their products are also in our shop www.bikeskills.cz/shop . Luxurious suspension, pedals and cockpit, on…
levelsportkoncept-testing-by-bikeskills.obsah:
Last weekend we had the chance to test components from our partner Levelsportkoncept.cz – their products are also in our shop www.bikeskills.cz/shop .

Luxurious suspension, pedals and cockpit, on both 27.5" and 29" bikes. We still film videos as amateurs, and the guys filming us had very shaky hands (probably from excitement about the bikes, or something .)), but anyway we enjoyed the ride and let the bikes have a drink of mud.

Besides team riders Mára Tryner, Lukáš Valný (at the time with a dislocated shoulder) and Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, guys from our www.mtbtrial.cz club joined in too (the Koudelák brothers, Martin Dostál, Matouš Balík).


Thanks for the loan, www.levelsportkoncept.cz – hopefully next time in a slightly more professional mode. (I'm saving up for a phone with stabilisation.)

sraz-veteranu-horni-police-a-mestske-sla.titulek: Veteran vehicle meet in Horní Police and town festival in Staré Křečany
sraz-veteranu-horni-police-a-mestske-sla.perex: This Saturday a slightly more demanding weekend awaited us. Martin Šimůnek, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Matouš Balík headed north for a double exhibition in Horní Police, which was unusually located…
sraz-veteranu-horni-police-a-mestske-sla.obsah:
This Saturday a slightly more demanding weekend awaited us. Martin Šimůnek, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and Matouš Balík headed north for a double exhibition in Horní Police, which was unusually located between the historic and the new bridge. Spectators could watch the action from the tents in front of the stage as well as from the pedestrian zone and the pavements on the bridges. The slightly complicated surface didn't faze the guys, and the exhibitions drew a large crowd. 

In the break between shows the guys went to test a nearby bike park that could be a venue for Bikeskills.cz coaching courses. After returning and riding the second exhibition they set off for Staré Křečany, which is just a stone's throw from the German border.

The festival in Křečany was in grand style. Concerts, security, a precisely set schedule. Our job was to fill the slot before one of the main bands. We rode just about everything we could fit in, including bigger jumps on the trailer and a Šluknov sandwich over volunteers :)

kulovy-blesk-2-caslav-bratronice-chotec-.titulek: Ball Lightning 2 – Čáslav, Bratronice, Choteč, Suchdol, Bojkovice
kulovy-blesk-2-caslav-bratronice-chotec-.perex: Sunday was literally like the famous Czech film Ball Lightning. 3 teams, 5 locations, 6 shows and two stops swapping riders. An incredible onslaught, where one or two mishaps would have made…
kulovy-blesk-2-caslav-bratronice-chotec-.obsah:
Sunday was literally like the famous Czech film Ball Lightning. 3 teams, 5 locations, 6 shows and two stops swapping riders. An incredible onslaught, where one or two mishaps would have made everything collapse like a house of cards.

In the morning our host dropped out because of a voice problem, so Vlasta had to host the exhibition at Great-Grandpa's Tractor, contrary to plan. Every cloud has a silver lining, and thanks to little Márty, whom he took along, the exhibition was ridden with 3 riders straight away. From Čáslav we went to Bratronice near Kladno, where Martin Šimůnek with Vlasta and Petr Jeřicha – who almost didn't make it because his car broke down – ran a workshop and an exhibition. The Kabeláč sisters helped too, joining in the riding. 

In the end the Čáslav squad also arrived in Bratronice, the riders were reshuffled, and Lukáš Valný, Vlasta, the girls and Tobík Dolák set off for a children's day in Choteč. Martin Šimůnek and Matouš, on the other hand, went to Suchdol for the local sports festival. Petr Jeřicha took his car to be serviced, and meanwhile in Moravia Mára Tryner and Michal Budský were warming up at Slavex bike park before the exhibition in Bojkovice.

Beautiful weather and great turnouts at all events were refreshing and motivating for us. Vlasta and Tobík even managed a short training session in the forest afterwards. Next weekend we continue at a slightly more relaxed pace. Thanks to all the organisers for the invitations and to the riders for their performances. We have a video from Mára and Michal in the article :)

camp-holky-ladi-bikeskill-3-a-exhibice-l.titulek: Women Tune Up with Bikeskills camp no. 3 and the Ledenice potato pancake festival exhibition
camp-holky-ladi-bikeskill-3-a-exhibice-l.perex: Organising a women's camp and an exhibition in Ledenice on the same day was a bit of a challenge for us, mainly because of a lot of illness and the absence of guys from the club. In the end we…
camp-holky-ladi-bikeskill-3-a-exhibice-l.obsah:
Organising a women's camp and an exhibition in Ledenice on the same day was a bit of a challenge for us, mainly because of a lot of illness and the absence of guys from the club. In the end we managed to put together a team for both events. This time the camp was led by Mára Tryner, Katarína Tóthová and Matouš Balík, assisted in the morning by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček.

Around noon, though, Vlasta and Lukáš Valný headed for Ledenice, where the local association's traditional event with a potato pancake cooking contest was taking place. The exhibition in two shows on the square in beautiful weather was great, thanks also to the turnout and the cheering. 

On the other side of the country, women and girls had the chance to take their skills to the next level and, under the guidance of Mára and Katarína, try out what they can do. 

And as if that weren't enough, a recording from Říčanské Šlapačky 2021 was on TV – thanks to the Lvíčata team :) From 18:00: https://decko.ceskatelevize.cz/lvicata

elektrobikefestival-a-exhibice-pro-mests.obsah:
Over the weekend we organised the first edition of elektrobikefestival.cz in Říčany. Two days of e-bike testing, exhibitions, a raffle and interesting talks looked grim because of the weather, but after the Saturday morning rain, e-bike enthusiasts started arriving in the afternoon. On Sunday it was full on in beautiful sunny weather. Ivan Mejstský took care of the right atmosphere. The exhibitions were provided by our Trialshow.cz team under the supervision of the festival's father, Pavel Hájek. Besides the kid riders, Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, Lukáš Valný, Tobík Dolák and, on Sunday, Martin Šimůnek performed, and other team members came along outside the shows too.


On Saturday there were also several exhibitions for the Prague Municipal Police, led by Mára Tryner and Michal Budský.

produkty-kine-max-na-nasem-shopu.obsah:
Anyone who has ever experienced an injury, instability or another problem has surely come across Kine-MAX tapes. But the manufacturer doesn't live on tapes alone – the brand's portfolio also includes many other products: balance pads and balls, skipping ropes, massage rollers and balls, and resistance bands.

Every biker who goes all in will surely use some of these products, which we use ourselves, and we hope they'll help you progress in what you're doing or prevent injury.

Products in our shop: https://shop.bikeskills.cz/en/

chlapi-ladi-bikeskills-2-2.popis:
Once again the camp is for all bikers, riders and guys on bikes who can take a bit of advice and like learning new things. From the perspective of riders and racers, we'll teach you what and how to train and what to focus on. Pump track, trails, berms, corners, brake control, balance, and also awareness of the bike itself in the form of a short workshop. For the braver ones there are smaller benches, mini doubles, small drops and semi-legal trails in the area.

LOCATION:

The Tehov leisure park and its surroundings are a great place to learn something. In cooperation with the municipality of Tehov, the local park was built and developed for leisure activities, including cycling. There are also plenty of trails nearby for technique coaching

On the pump track you'll practise pumping, flow and a few jumps for those who fancy it. We can practise riding without pedalling, riding rhythm, pedal position in corners, or riding properly fast.

There's also a Skills centre – in other words, what to avoid and what to try riding over on a ride. Maybe even get into the basics of Trial a little.

Park: Google Maps link

Parking by the park: Google Maps link

Parking in front of Vlasta's house: Google Maps link

(please don't block the street or others' exit from the car park)

You can also get to the park by train from Světice or Říčany station. You can also ride to us directly from Prague along the Kolovraty – Mnichovice cycle path, turning off in Světice.

SUITABLE FOR:

Men and boys aged 18+, or younger by arrangement if accompanied by parents. If we split into groups, they will be divided by ability. In terms of ability, it's suitable for off-road beginners to intermediate riders. Advanced riders are welcome too – everyone can have a weak spot in their technique they want to practise.

EQUIPMENT:

  • Mountain bike (MTB) or an e-bike with switchable assistance, in good technical condition.
  • Helmet, sports shoes or bike shoes for flat pedals.

trialovy-kurz-unor-hala-4.popis:
Bikeskills Trial courses give you the chance to work on your balance, overcoming obstacles and other skills that come in handy but there's no time to train during the season. Everyone can improve their position on the bike or try riding up a few pallets.

Riders from most MTB disciplines use Trial as winter preparation. You can of course try Trial as more than just a supplement, and thanks to our course get a proper feel for it for the first time.

Training will take place in our new heated club hall (Nupaky near Říčany). We'll lend you a bike, because a mountain bike isn't suitable for indoor Trial training. The hall in Nupaky fits 2–3 riders at a time. The hall is heated with a blower heater.

Training is led by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, 10-time Czech Elite champion in mountain bike Trial and holder of Czech jumping records. He also did quite well in international races, where he was among the world's TOP 15 riders and won the UCI European Cup. He has been through many injuries and the now dead end of Biketrial, and through club training and teaching MTB and Trial to the public he has gained plenty of coaching experience that he can now pass on to you. If necessary, other leading Czech riders from our team (Marek Tryner or Lukáš Valný) will step in.



LOCATION:

The course takes place at Nupacká 112, Nupaky 251 01, in a barn converted into a Trial hall. So you can train regardless of weather and light conditions. The venue is accessible by car / bus. Parking is available nearby.

Mostly wooden obstacles on a concrete surface are available.

Hall location: Google Maps link

Men, women and children. Children only when accompanied by parents, on an individual basis. Ideal for beginners, amateur and professional riders.

chlapi-ladi-bikeskills-2-2023.popis:
A camp for riders who want to push their off-road abilities, polish what they already know to gain confidence and move forward. We'll ride trails, berms, small drops and technically demanding descents, and go through how to use the brakes correctly. There's also room for smaller benches and doubles, depending on what participants fancy. Riding over smaller obstacles with balance and a workshop focused on bike maintenance won't be missing either.

All under the guidance of Elite Czech Trial riders / Enduro riders and downhillers. https://bikeskills.cz

LOCATION:

The Tehov leisure park and its surroundings are a great place to learn something. In cooperation with the municipality of Tehov, the local park was built and developed for leisure activities, including cycling. The technical trail will help us practise handling berms, rock gardens, sharp corners and other features you may come across off-road.

On the pump track you'll practise pumping and flow, and for the more skilled we have a jump line ready. We can practise riding without pedalling, riding rhythm, pedal position in corners, or riding properly fast. There are also Trial obstacles – in other words, what to avoid and what to try riding over on a ride.

There are also a few interesting spots nearby for practising drops and technical descents, plus illegal trails.

Park: Google Maps link

Parking by the park: Google Maps link

Parking in front of Vlasta's house: Google Maps link

(please don't block the street or others' exit from the car park)

You can also get to the park by train from Světice or Říčany station. You can also ride to us directly from Prague along the Kolovraty – Mnichovice cycle path, turning off in Světice.

SUITABLE FOR:

Men, young boys and lads aged 18+, or younger by arrangement if accompanied by parents (ideally also men). Groups will be divided by ability. In terms of ability, it's suitable for off-road beginners to intermediate riders. Advanced riders are welcome too – everyone can have a weak spot in their technique they want to practise. Write to us and we'll happily advise whether the camp is right for you.

EQUIPMENT:

  • Mountain bike (MTB) or an e-bike with switchable assistance, in good technical condition.
  • Helmet, sports shoes or bike shoes for flat pedals.
  • We strongly recommend leaving clipless pedals at home and bringing ordinary flat pedals. If you let us know in advance, we'll happily lend you some on site and swap them ourselves.
  • Spare clothes.
  • We recommend gloves – ideally full-finger.
  • Insurance is up to each rider, but we recommend at least accident insurance.

WHAT WE HAVE READY FOR YOU:

  • Lunch, snacks, fruit and drinks.
  • Equipment for minor servicing of your darlings (we mean bikes).
  • Obstacles for practising basic skills and small facilities.

Lunch at the great restaurant of Hotel Legner Zvánovice!

Training will take place in our new heated club hall (Prague-Nedvězí). We'll lend you a bike, because a mountain bike isn't suitable for indoor Trial training. The number of bikes also limits the maximum number of riders, which gives us the chance to focus on you more.

You can choose from Friday or Saturday dates. In case of a one-off absence, one replacement day will be set for everyone who can't attend all 3 sessions.

Training is led by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, 10-time Czech Elite champion in mountain bike Trial and holder of Czech jumping records. He also did quite well in international races, where he was among the world's TOP 15 riders and won the UCI European Cup. He has been through many injuries and the now dead end of Biketrial, and through club training and teaching MTB and Trial to the public he has gained plenty of coaching experience that he can now pass on to you. If necessary, other leading Czech riders from our team (Marek Tryner or Lukáš Valný) will step in.



LOCATION:

The course takes place in Nedvězí (Prague-Nedvězí, near Říčany), where an even bigger and better-equipped hall than last year is ready for this year. zimni-mtb-trial-kurz-1.popis:
Hang your bike up in the garage over winter? No way! We have a 3-day indoor Trial course for you. You'll improve your balance, learn to ride over a beam and up onto pallets, get the correct position on the bike and learn a few other tricks you'll find priceless off-road. We know how demanding Trial looks to many riders at first glance. Thanks to our experience we believe that within a few lessons you'll understand the basics of how to develop in this discipline and combine it with your main one. Bike rental is included in the price.


LOCATION:

The course takes place in Mnichovice (near Říčany), where a luxurious hall of the MTB & Trial Mraveniště club is ready this year. So you can train regardless of weather and light conditions. The venue is accessible by train, and parking is available in the closed site.

Mostly wooden obstacles on a rough concrete floor are available.

You can also walk to the venue from Mnichovice train station.

chlapi-ladi-bikeskills-5.popis:
A camp for guys who want to push their off-road abilities, polish what they already know to gain confidence and move forward. We'll ride trails, berms, small drops and technically demanding short descents, and go through how to use the brakes correctly. There's also room for smaller benches and doubles, depending on what participants fancy. Riding over smaller obstacles with balance and a workshop focused on our darlings (we don't mean wives and girlfriends) won't be missing either.

LOCATION:

The Tehov leisure park and its surroundings are a great place to learn something. In cooperation with the municipality of Tehov, the local park was built and developed for leisure activities, including cycling. The technical trail will help us practise handling berms, rock gardens, sharp corners and other features you may come across off-road.

On the pump track you'll practise pumping and flow, and for the more skilled we have small jumps ready. We can practise riding without pedalling, riding rhythm, pedal position in corners, or riding properly fast.

There are also Trial obstacles – in other words, what to avoid and what to try riding over on a ride.

There are also a few interesting spots nearby for practising drops and technical descents.

trialovy-kurz-prosinec-hala.popis:
It's no longer bike weather outside, so why not pop into the hall to refine your technique? Riders from most MTB disciplines use Trial as winter preparation. You can of course try Trial as more than just a supplement, and thanks to our course get a proper feel for it for the first time.

You'll train balance and the correct position on the bike, we'll go through braking technique, and maybe lay the foundations for a climb or a jump.

Training will take place in our new heated club hall (Prague-Nedvězí). We'll lend you a bike, because a mountain bike isn't suitable for indoor Trial training. The number of bikes also limits the maximum number of riders, which gives us the chance to focus on you more.

You can choose from Friday or Saturday dates. In case of a one-off absence, one replacement day will be set for everyone who can't attend all 3 sessions.

Training is led by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, 10-time Czech Elite champion in mountain bike Trial and holder of Czech jumping records. He also did quite well in international races, where he was among the world's TOP 15 riders and won the UCI European Cup. He has been through many injuries and the now dead end of Biketrial, and through club training and teaching MTB and Trial to the public he has gained plenty of coaching experience that he can now pass on to you. If necessary, other leading Czech riders from our team (Marek Tryner or Lukáš Valný) will step in.



LOCATION:

The course takes place in Nedvězí (Prague-Nedvězí, near Říčany), where an even bigger and better-equipped hall than last year is ready for this year. So you can train regardless of weather and light conditions. The venue is accessible by car / bus. A modest shower and WC are available, including our own parking.

Mostly wooden obstacles on carpet / anti-slip tiles are available.

trialovy-kurz-leden-hala.popis:
Too little snow, too much snow, or just cold. Simply the ideal time to pop into the hall on a bike to refine your technique. Riders from most MTB disciplines use Trial as winter preparation. You can of course try Trial as more than just a supplement, and thanks to our course get a proper feel for it for the first time.

You'll train balance and the correct position on the bike, we'll go through braking technique, and maybe lay the foundations for a climb or a jump.

Training will take place in our new heated club hall (Prague-Nedvězí). We'll lend you a bike, because a mountain bike isn't suitable for indoor Trial training. The number of bikes also limits the maximum number of riders, which gives us the chance to focus on you more.

You can choose from Friday or Saturday dates. In case of a one-off absence, one replacement day will be set for everyone who can't attend all 3 sessions.

Training is led by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, 10-time Czech Elite champion in mountain bike Trial and holder of Czech jumping records. He also did quite well in international races, where he was among the world's TOP 15 riders and won the UCI European Cup. He has been through many injuries and the now dead end of Biketrial, and through club training and teaching MTB and Trial to the public he has gained plenty of coaching experience that he can now pass on to you. If necessary, other leading Czech riders from our team (Marek Tryner or Lukáš Valný) will step in.



LOCATION:

The course takes place in Nedvězí (Prague-Nedvězí, near Říčany), where an even bigger and better-equipped hall than last year is ready for this year. So you can train regardless of weather and light conditions. The venue is accessible by car / bus. A modest shower and WC are available, including our own parking.

Mostly wooden obstacles on carpet / anti-slip tiles are available.

chlapi-ladi-bikeskills-4.popis:
We're holding our fourth camp for men again in Zvánovice / Struhařov, in the beautiful surroundings of the Říčany and Struhařov forests. We'll focus on drops, descents and root sections, as well as riding over rocks. Dealing with critical situations off-road. Riding down or dropping whatever nature puts in front of your wheels, brake control, steep climbs and lots of other tricks you'll find useful on the bike – all in one package.

LOCATION:

Struhařov and Zvánovice are a destination for many bikers, and the local forests and surroundings are full of surprises. There's practically everything you might encounter off the trails. We'll cover the basics of technique at the Master Horse Club grounds. The newly chosen venue is right next to rocky fields and several descents. On the way we'll come across rocks, fords, descents and climbs – all in the beautiful landscape of Josef Lada's country. For lunch we'll turn around at the Master Horse restaurant and head to the other side of the valley, where there's the option to ride some slightly sharper stuff.

individualni-trialovy-kurz-zima.popis:
Take advantage of winter training in a heated hall or outdoors (weather permitting). A Trial course will help you work on your balance, overcoming obstacles and other skills that come in handy but there's no time to train during the season. Everyone can improve their position on the bike or try riding up a few pallets.

Riders from most MTB disciplines use Trial as winter preparation. You can of course try Trial as more than just a supplement, and thanks to our course get a proper feel for it for the first time.

Training will take place in our new heated club hall (Nupaky near Říčany). We'll lend you a bike, because a mountain bike isn't suitable for indoor Trial training. The hall in Nupaky fits 2–3 riders at a time. The hall is heated with a blower heater.

Training is led by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, 10-time Czech Elite champion in mountain bike Trial and holder of Czech jumping records. He also did quite well in international races, where he was among the world's TOP 15 riders and won the UCI European Cup. He has been through many injuries and the now dead end of Biketrial, and through club training and teaching MTB and Trial to the public he has gained plenty of coaching experience that he can now pass on to you. If necessary, other leading Czech riders from our team (Marek Tryner or Lukáš Valný) will step in.

You can choose from Friday or Saturday dates. In case of a one-off absence, one replacement day will be set for everyone who can't attend all 3 sessions.

Training is led by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, 10-time Czech Elite champion in mountain bike Trial and holder of Czech jumping records. chlapi-ladi-bikeskills-1.popis:
Once again the camp is for all bikers, riders and guys on bikes who can take a bit of advice and like learning new things. From the perspective of riders and racers, we'll teach you what and how to train and what to focus on. Pump track, trails, berms, corners, brake control, balance, and also awareness of the bike itself in the form of a short workshop. For the braver ones there are smaller benches, mini doubles, small drops and semi-legal trails in the area. From this year we're e-bike friendly – if your e-bike is suitable for off-road riding, you can sign up with it too.

LOCATION:

This year we have more training locations available. The Tehov leisure park and its surroundings are a great place to learn something on the pump track, in the skills centre and on the benches. On the pump track you'll practise pumping and flow, and for the more skilled we have benches ready. We can practise riding without pedalling, riding rhythm, pedal position in corners, or riding properly fast. In cooperation with the municipality of Tehov, the local park was built and developed for leisure activities, including cycling.

In nearby Říčany we helped build a small trail, including several jumps and a drop-in from a tower.

There are also plenty of forest spots nearby for practising technique on roots or trails. For the braver ones there are doubles and drops, or root sections and real Enduro.

Park: Google Maps link

Parking by the park: Google Maps link

Parking in front of Vlasta's house: Google Maps link

(please don't block the street or others' exit from the car park)

You can also get to the park where we start by train, from Světice or Říčany station. You can also ride to us directly from Prague along the Kolovraty – Mnichovice cycle path, turning off in Světice.

SUITABLE FOR:

Men and boys aged 18+, or younger by arrangement if accompanied by parents. If we split into groups, they will be divided by ability. In terms of ability, it's suitable for off-road beginners to intermediate riders. Advanced riders are welcome too – everyone can have a weak spot in their technique they want to practise.

EQUIPMENT:

  • Mountain bike (MTB) or an e-bike with switchable assistance, in good technical condition.
  • Helmet, sports shoes or bike shoes for flat pedals.
  • We strongly recommend leaving clipless pedals at home and bringing ordinary flat pedals. If you let us know in advance, we'll happily lend you some on site and swap them ourselves.
  • Spare clothes.
  • We recommend gloves – ideally full-finger.
  • Insurance is up to each rider, but we recommend at least accident insurance.

WHAT WE HAVE READY FOR YOU:

  • Lunch, snacks, fruit and drinks.
  • Equipment for minor servicing of your darlings (we mean bikes).
  • Obstacles for practising basic skills and small facilities.

holky-ladi-bikeskills-2.popis:
The second camp for women will be held in Zvánovice / Struhařov, in the beautiful surroundings of the Říčany and Struhařov forests. It's for female riders who want to improve their off-road riding (roots, a ford, flat rock, or even a descent). We'll focus on how to get down a hill safely or ride over anything you may meet along the way off-road. If you can ride a trail and want to broaden your horizons, this is the camp for you. The camp has a lower capacity to ensure safety during coaching.

LOCATION:

Struhařov and Zvánovice are a destination for many bikers, and the local forests and surroundings are full of surprises. There's practically everything you might encounter off the trails. We'll cover the basics of technique at the Master Horse Club grounds. The newly chosen venue is right next to rocky fields and several descents. On the way we'll come across rocks, fords, descents and climbs – all in the beautiful landscape of Josef Lada's country. For lunch we'll turn around at the Master Horse restaurant and head to the other side of the valley, where there's the option to ride some slightly sharper stuff.

trialovy-kurz-unor-hala.popis:
The season is approaching, and even in February we have a chance for you to train on the bike and improve your technique a little. You'll train balance and the correct position on the bike, we'll go through braking technique, and maybe lay the foundations for a climb or a jump.

Trial is a great foundation for all bike disciplines, and we're happy to pass on the experience we have as active riders. And there's quite a lot of it from the last 30 years :)

Training will take place in our heated club hall. We'll lend you a bike, because a mountain bike isn't suitable for indoor Trial training. The number of bikes also limits the maximum number of riders, which gives us the chance to focus on you more.

You can choose from Friday or Saturday dates. In case of a one-off absence, one replacement day will be set for everyone who can't attend all 3 sessions.

Training is led by Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček, 10-time Czech Elite champion in mountain bike Trial and holder of Czech jumping records. He also did quite well in international races, where he was among the world's TOP 15 riders and won the UCI European Cup. He has been through many injuries and the now dead end of Biketrial, and through club training and teaching MTB and Trial to the public he has gained plenty of coaching experience that he can now pass on to you. holky-ladi-bikeskills-2-2023.popis:
Once again the camp is for all female riders who want to learn something new, try more ways of riding a mountain bike and push their skills a little further. Pump track, trails, berms, corners, brake control, balance, and also awareness of the bike itself in the form of a short workshop. For the braver ones there are smaller benches, mini doubles and small drops. All in a one-day course for women, girls and young ladies.

LOCATION:

The Tehov leisure park and its surroundings are a great place to learn something. In cooperation with the municipality of Tehov, the local park was built and developed for leisure activities, including cycling. The technical trail will help us practise handling berms, rock gardens, sharp corners and other features you may come across off-road.

On the pump track you'll practise pumping and flow, and for the more skilled we have small jumps ready. We can practise riding without pedalling, riding rhythm, pedal position in corners, or riding properly fast.

There are also Trial obstacles – in other words, what to avoid and what to try riding over on a ride.

You can also get to the park by train from Světice or Říčany station. You can also ride to us directly from Prague along the Kolovraty – Mnichovice cycle path, turning off in Světice.

SUITABLE FOR:

Women and girls aged 18+, or younger by arrangement if accompanied by parents (ideally also women). Groups will be divided by ability. In terms of ability, it's suitable for off-road beginners to intermediate riders. Advanced riders are welcome too – everyone can have a weak spot in their technique they want to practise.

EQUIPMENT:

  • Mountain bike (MTB) or an e-bike with switchable assistance, in good technical condition.
  • Helmet, sports shoes or bike shoes for flat pedals.
  • We strongly recommend leaving clipless pedals at home and bringing ordinary flat pedals. If you let us know in advance, we'll happily lend you some on site and swap them ourselves.
  • Spare clothes.
  • We recommend gloves – ideally full-finger.
  • Insurance is up to each rider, but we recommend at least accident insurance.

WHAT WE HAVE READY FOR YOU:

  • Lunch, snacks, fruit and drinks.
  • Equipment for minor servicing of your darlings (we mean bikes).
  • Obstacles for practising basic skills and small facilities.

Lunch and a sit-down at the great restaurant of Hotel Legner Zvánovice!

mara-tryner.popis: I've lived for cycling since I was young – my parents led me to it, or rather, bikes were never missing in our family and accompanied me throughout my childhood, whether it was a folding bike, a BMX, an MTB or a road bike. I got into cycle trial at 14, when I saw someone jumping on a bike over benches for the first time in my life. It was Michal Budský on a 20” bike. All at a time when I was racing MTB for Cykloprag Praha. Since then I've been hooked on cycle trial, and Michal Budský became my teacher.< I started on my old 26” Scott Vail MTB, which took a real beating during my first steps in trial. Suspension fork, chainrings, derailleur – basically everything went to pieces. In the end I bought an old, cracked 20” trial bike for about CZK 6,000, and since then I've gone through about 4 more bikes. In the following years, while studying at the Faculty of Civil Engineering in Brno, I switched to 26” bikes and gradually started riding cycle trial under the UCI, or rather the Czech Cycling Federation. In 2008 I founded my own online shop for trial components, which still operates today and which I keep trying to move forward. It also allows me to test new components, and I try to pass my experience on to customers so that everything suits them as well as possible. I don't sell….I help. In 2015 I joined the Czech national team, i.e. the national cycle trial squad, and took part in the European Championships in Italy and France. A great experience! In 2016 I managed to beat my trial teacher in the Czech Championship. There was no rivalry between us, but I was honestly glad that he had passed his experience on to me so well that I could use it even against him. I'll never forget that. Thank you! What next? It's time to pass my experience on in turn….. RESULTS2014 – runner-up in the Czech Cup, ELITE 26” category2015 – winner of the Czech Cup, ELITE 26” category2016 – winner of the Czech Cup, ELITE 26” category2016 – runner-up at the Czech Championship, Elite 26” categoryMember of the Czech national team and many other results and sporting achievements … ‍

katarina-tothova.popis: I started mountain biking at 15. Shortly after that I got into a downhill team and, with almost no experience, started racing straight away. Then I added four-cross, BMX racing and, in the last few years, enduro. I've raced in the Czech Cup and the World Cup. After almost 20 years on the bike, I love passing my experience on, whether to kids, men or women – and I love giving women the courage to see that you can have fun on a bike and that you can ride down anything. Even so, I keep trying to improve on the bike as much as time and my kids allow. RESULTS 2007 – national downhill champion 2008 – national downhill champion 2008 – national runner-up in four-cross 2008 – 6th place at the four-cross World Cup in Andorra Member of the Czech national downhill team

lukas-valny.popis: Luky is another one of those who can't write a few lines about himself for his profile. A stubborn, pumped-up pocket-sized man capable of big jumps – and big crashes. He's considered our club's biggest die-hard in terms of work done, hours ridden and jumps crashed. Like Petr Jeřicha, Luky grew up on the bike alongside Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček and worked his way up from village Trial rider to newcomer in the Elite category on 20″ trial bikes. He started at a later age, but he's clear proof that with regular training alongside better riders you can reach a decent level quickly and painlessly. He's into a whole range of other sports, including the opposite sex. After a short break and a one-year drop to the Expert category, he fulfilled his dream and won the Czech amateur championship title. RESULTSCzech champion, EXPERT categoryCzech runner-up, EXPERT categoryWinner of the 2015 OPEN FREE series4th place at the indoor cup in Germanyand many wins at Czech Cup races and open races ‍

martin-simunek.popis: “Šimon” is one of the legends of the trial sport – a three-time world champion of the BIU (Biketrial) federation in the era before the world's riders left and the sport practically died out – and one of the most successful Trial representatives under the Czech Cycling Federation (UCI), winning the title of UCI world runner-up. Martin truly reached the very top of the Trial sport by competing at the world championships of both disciplines. Racing is no longer a priority for him, but even so he took second place in the 2011 Czech Trial Cup under the Czech Cycling Federation and won a number of Trial contests. Besides racing, he has collected and keeps collecting records on bikes – his biggest, still unbeaten record is riding up the Petřín lookout tower by hopping up the stairs, setting a time of 6:18 min on 30 March 1993. Today Martin focuses on exhibition performances and organising sports, cultural and social events as part of the TRIALSHOW.cz team. He can handle everything from hosting to management and logistics. He's a leading figure and a motivation for many riders, from beginners to the best Czech professional riders. RESULTS11x Czech champion6x Czech indoor championUCI world runner-up3x BIU world champion (back when that title was worth fighting for)and many more results that our screen resolution wouldn't be enough for … ‍

vlasta.popis:
... whom nobody on the team calls anything but Čihi, is one of the most successful Czech Trial riders of the professional UCI federation, taught to ride by riders such as Martin Šimůnek, Josef Dressler and Roman Chvojka. He comes from the birthplace of the Czech trial sport, Říčany near Prague. He lives in Tehov, where he has some of the best conditions for his own training and that of his club colleagues.


Čihi currently rides for POC helmets, MALOJA, LEZYNE, GATORADE and TM Servis – the technical motion. Vlasta proudly rides for the MTB & TRIAL Mraveniště Říčany club.


RESULTS

Čihi has several times been the highest-ranked Czech rider in the UCI ranking – in 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2014 and 2016 in the Elite 26´´ category (20´´ only in some years).

Czech champion 2012, 2013, 2015, 2016, 2017

Czech indoor champion 2013

Czech champion in jumps on a 26″ mountain bike 2017, 2018

Czech champion in jumps on a 20″ trial bike 2017,

Unofficial Czech champion in ENDURO TRIAL 2014, 2018

Winner of the Czech Trial Cup 2010, 2011, 2012

Winner of the UCI European Cup 2010

Second place at C1 category races 2015 and 2016

Winner of the TRIAL cup 2011 and 2012, 12th place at the UCI European Championships 2015

2nd place in the Czech Trial Cup 2002,

3rd at the Czech Championship – ČSC Trial 2003,

6-time Czech record holder

Guinness record holder for hopping up and riding down the Petřín lookout tower

Two years in a row he made it into the TOP 20 professionals at the World Championships, and as the first Czech rider he was invited to the TrialPro series for the world's top 20 riders.

1st place at Říčany Trial – Reborn,

15th place at the UCI European Championships 2011,

17th place in the World Cup 2009 and 19th place in 2008, and many more results …
